ca395d166036.curator_note: Friday's edition of the rooftop series you keep coming back to — eight floors over DTLA, sun going down, rotating local house DJs keeping it smooth and skip-free. Free with RSVP, so just walk in early before it caps.
ca395d166036.description: Weekly Friday rooftop house party (5-10pm) at Golden Hour on Level 8 in downtown LA, with rotating local DJs.

a1aee8bcdfae.curator_note: A long-running soulful-electronic night at El Cid for $7 — the kind of low-key, groove-forward room where the selection does the work and nobody's filming. Easy eastside add to a Friday.
a1aee8bcdfae.description: Soulful electronic dance night at El Cid in Silver Lake, doors 10pm, $7.

artist_notes.name: DJ Nuts
artist_notes.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

artist_notes.name: Cut Chemist
artist_notes.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

918a63422186.curator_note: A Mochilla-style 'Like No One Is Watching' digger summit — DJ Nuts and Cut Chemist trading rare grooves with Detroit's Waajeed in the mix. Less peak-time, more for people who care about where the records come from; the Friday move if you'd rather nerd out than rage.
918a63422186.description: Mochilla's 'Like No One Is Watching' all-vinyl global-beats party at 2220 Arts + Archives with DJ Nuts, Waajeed, Cut Chemist and guests; $20.

8d2a98275ab5.curator_note: Vidiots kicks off a Bill Duke weekend with his 1992 LA narco-noir — Laurence Fishburne undercover, Jeff Goldblum sleazy, and an underrated entry in early-'90s Black cinema. Good excuse to finally try the Eagle Rock theater you've been meaning to hit.
8d2a98275ab5.description: Bill Duke's 1992 neo-noir 'Deep Cover' (108 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 7pm, opening a weekend tribute to the director.

artist_notes.name: SHDW
artist_notes.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

2d20ff8e0c2b.curator_note: An all-night-long set from one of modern techno's rhythm specialists, location-TBA-until-two-hours-before like WORK always does it. This is the proper hypnotic-techno end of the weekend — go if you want one DJ taking you the whole way, not the rooftop-groove night.
2d20ff8e0c2b.description: WORK presents German techno DJ SHDW (Mutual Rytm) for an all-night-long set at a location-TBA warehouse in LA, 11pm, tickets from $30.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

0f24a39aa490.curator_note: Bradley Zero headlining a Midnight Lovers open-air day party is about as close to that Sunset Sessions feeling as the weekend gets — sun, disco-leaning house, real selection, no requests. Build Saturday around the 5pm start.
0f24a39aa490.description: Midnight Lovers summer open-air day party at The Bridge with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero plus Masha Mar and LA selectors, from 5pm.

7d0bd069c0e5.curator_note: A sapphic Pride-weekend day party — more community-and-vibes than a billed-DJ night, so it's about the room, not the selection. On the radar if Pride is the priority over the music.
7d0bd069c0e5.description: Sapphic Pride day party 'Hot Girl Summer' at Untamed Spirits, from 3pm, $10.

f44b5d9fe86c.curator_note: Gold Diggers' twice-monthly disco party in East Hollywood — a reliably fun late Saturday for boogie and classic house in an intimate room a short hop from Silver Lake. No headliner billed, but the residents know the format.
f44b5d9fe86c.description: 'The Hustle' first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

96c73b45a50b.curator_note: A Juneteenth-weekend morning run/wellness gathering at CAAM in Exposition Park — a culture-and-community event, not a music one. Mentioning it for the weekend context, not the lane.
96c73b45a50b.description: Free 'Run The Culture' morning run and community event at the California African American Museum, 9am.

artist_notes.name: Neeko
artist_notes.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

cc5a11b4ddb8.curator_note: Sunday Sessions is one of the bigger vinyl-only crews in the country, and this is their open-air Apotheke session — exactly the all-wax, no-laptop house you want closing out a solstice Sunday. Low-key but the real deal.
cc5a11b4ddb8.description: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only open-air house session at Apotheke with residents Neeko and Krane, from 6pm.

5dcdfc5a574d.curator_note: Bill Duke was in the cast, which is why Vidiots slots 'Predator' into his weekend — and a 35mm print of the 1987 jungle classic is the right way to see it. Already sold out, so it's a 'if you have a ticket' note.
5dcdfc5a574d.description: John McTiernan's 'Predator' (1987, 107 min) on 35mm at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 3:30pm, as part of the Bill Duke weekend — SOLD OUT.

artist_notes.name: AYYBO
artist_notes.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

artist_notes.name: Ragie Ban
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

6af20e062172.curator_note: The first of a three-night Lake takeover of the park, and the 18+ Friday is the loosest of them — go for the wide-open-field, hands-up version of his sound rather than a tasteful one.
6af20e062172.description: Goldenvoice/Framework present Chris Lake headlining an open-air tech-house party at LA State Historic Park, with AYYBO and Ragie Ban (18+).

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Josh Caffé
artist_notes.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

750cc2565824.curator_note: A location-TBA late one pairing a Detroit lifer with one of the few real vocalists in house — the kind of small, queer-leaning warehouse night that tends to outshine the big rooms this weekend.
750cc2565824.description: Late-night TBA-location house party with Detroit's DJ Minx and London vocalist-DJ Josh Caffé.

artist_notes.name: FARRALONE
artist_notes.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

35bde3a221a0.curator_note: Free-with-RSVP weekly leaning disco and nu-disco — low-stakes and unpretentious, the kind of spot to start a Friday before something bigger rather than make the whole night.
35bde3a221a0.description: Free weekly disco/nu-disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang with residents FARRALONE and Alex D.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer (Dirt Tech Reck, ex-Slum Village camp) — tracked artist; soulful, politically-charged techno and house from the source.

artist_notes.name: Trovarsi
artist_notes.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

artist_notes.name: E.M. Bae
artist_notes.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

artist_notes.name: 92Jelani
artist_notes.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

60356bc699f9.curator_note: A Juneteenth warehouse rave from Black Techno Matters with Waajeed anchoring it — techno reconnected to its Black Detroit roots, which is about the most meaningful way to spend the holiday on a dancefloor.
60356bc699f9.description: Juneteenth warehouse techno party (location TBA) presented by the Black Techno Matters collective, headlined by Detroit's Waajeed.

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

7d3eee612155.curator_note: The strongest night of the Lake run — adding Hot Since 82 gives the open-air a deeper, more European backbone than the Friday, so this is the one to prioritize if you only do one.
7d3eee612155.description: Chris Lake headlines LA State Historic Park with UK house don Hot Since 82 and Club de Combat (Goldenvoice/Framework).

artist_notes.name: Claude VonStroke
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

artist_notes.name: Ardalan
artist_notes.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch and Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Todd Edwards
artist_notes.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

artist_notes.name: Cut Snake
artist_notes.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

artist_notes.name: Falcons
artist_notes.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

367d5cd8ea2a.curator_note: World Cup watch party crossed with a Dirtybird-deep DJ marathon on giant LED screens — a goofy premise on paper, but a genuinely stacked all-day bill that justifies showing up even if you don't care about the football.
367d5cd8ea2a.description: KCRW x Copa Del Rave: an all-day World Cup watch-party-meets-rave at Academy LA with LED match screens and DJs including Claude VonStroke, Todd Edwards, DJ Minx and Ardalan.

artist_notes.name: Ak'chamel, The Giver of Illness
artist_notes.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

artist_notes.name: Derek Monypeny
artist_notes.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

d0dd0d0bf550.curator_note: Not an electronic night at all — this is the heady, masked-ritual psych-folk corner of Zebulon, worth it if you want a left-field listening experience instead of a dancefloor this weekend.
d0dd0d0bf550.description: Experimental psych-folk/drone bill at Zebulon: anonymous Texas duo Ak'chamel, plus Joshua Tree guitarist Derek Monypeny and Kelby Clark.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Rhythm Section International boss out of Peckham — tracked artist; genre-fluid digger (disco, broken beat, deep house) and a touchstone for exactly this rooftop/warehouse-groove taste.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector (NTS, dublab; co-founder of Dig Deeper LA) — cosmic disco, tribal and left-field deep house.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

82f9690b2933.curator_note: A 10-hour Bradley Zero session with two of LA's sharpest diggers warming up is the headphones-and-dancing pick of the weekend — build the night around this rather than treating it as a backup.
82f9690b2933.description: Midnight Lovers presents a long-form warehouse party with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero alongside Masha Mar, Xica Soul and Maddy Maia (5pm-3am).

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight and Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic extended sets.

404a1190c380.curator_note: The Sunday/Father's Day cap on the three-night park run — same Lake-and-Hot-Since-82 pairing as Saturday, so pick this only if the weekend night you want is already sold out.
404a1190c380.description: Third date of Chris Lake's LA State Historic Park run with Hot Since 82, an 18+ open-air tech-house party.

artist_notes.name: Cassian
artist_notes.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

artist_notes.name: Kamino
artist_notes.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

2f0dfdae90af.curator_note: Day Trip's daytime melodic-house format in the park, anchored by Cassian — the more emotional, Afterlife-leaning counterweight to the Lake tech-house weekend if peak-time isn't your mood.
2f0dfdae90af.description: Day Trip In The Park daytime melodic/progressive-house party at LA State Historic Park with Cassian, Kamino, Millero and LUMI.

artist_notes.name: Eddie C
artist_notes.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

78348cab1d1a.curator_note: An open-to-close set from Eddie C is exactly the kind of night to plant yourself for — no warmup DJ, no peak-time grandstanding, just one of the slo-mo disco crowd's best diggers building the room all night. Free with RSVP makes it a no-brainer.
78348cab1d1a.description: Eddie C plays an all-night open-to-close set of disco, edits and deep house at Bar Franca.

artist_notes.name: B-Wade
artist_notes.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

4fedbed9168f.curator_note: A recurring soulful-house residency in the back room of Gold Diggers — the warm, vocal, gospel-adjacent end of the spectrum rather than peak-time tools. Good low-key Friday if you want grooves over a big lineup.
4fedbed9168f.description: Recurring all-night soulful-house party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, hosted by resident B-Wade.

bb41161eefe6.curator_note: George Miller's desert-chase masterpiece on the big screen at Vidiots — relentless, practical-stunt insanity that's worth seeing loud and projected rather than at home. Ari's flagged Vidiots as a venue he wants to get into; this is a great excuse.
bb41161eefe6.description: Repertory screening of Mad Max: Fury Road (2015, 121 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock.

artist_notes.name: LYDO
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Frankie Teardrop
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

7aecfa91d404.curator_note: A queer warehouse rave for Pride leaning fast and trance-y — LYDO and Frankie Teardrop are the real-deal underground end of that sound, not a generic circuit party. Skews harder and more peak-time than the rooftop-groove lane, so go in for the energy, not for selection.
7aecfa91d404.description: Location-TBA Pride warehouse party with queer-underground techno from LYDO, Frankie Teardrop, Miracles and J.dB.

artist_notes.name: Tamara Lanza
artist_notes.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

2353e1ad635b.curator_note: The pool-party edition of Sunset Sessions — the rooftop-vinyl-house series at Level 8 that's basically Ari's reference point for a good open-air Saturday. The lineup's local-resident rather than a marquee guest, but the setting and sound are the whole reason to go.
2353e1ad635b.description: Saturday afternoon pool-party edition of the Sunset Sessions rooftop house series at Level 8 DTLA, with Aplex, Tamara Lanza and Electric Field.

artist_notes.name: Antal
artist_notes.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

ec2ca5e297c2.curator_note: We Own The Night marks 15 years of its no-velvet-ropes 'real LA underground rare house' parties by flying Antal in from Amsterdam for an extended set — that's a serious pairing of crowd and selector, and exactly the dirty-disco-into-house energy worth chasing a TBA address for.
ec2ca5e297c2.description: We Own The Night's 15-year anniversary at a TBA downtown location, with an extended set from Rush Hour's Antal flying in from Amsterdam.

artist_notes.name: Reverberation Radio
artist_notes.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

169931f6acf3.curator_note: Not a four-on-the-floor night — this is the Allah-Las' crate-digging crew spinning psych, surf, library and global oddities off vinyl at Zebulon. A great listening-bar-flavored hang if you want grooves and discovery instead of a dancefloor.
169931f6acf3.description: Allah-Las' Reverberation Radio crew DJ a night of vintage psych, surf and global vinyl obscurities at Zebulon in Frogtown.

cbf00da01c90.curator_note: A morning camera-and-coffee meetup for the photo/video crowd — gear talk, coffee and shooting, not a music thing. Off the main lane unless Ari's specifically into the photography-community side.
cbf00da01c90.description: Free morning photography/videographer community meetup (gear + coffee) hosted by Dangycam; address drops after RSVP approval.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

artist_notes.name: john gerrard
artist_notes.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

deede894fa33.curator_note: A free summer-solstice dance at LACMA pairing Richie Hawtin with John Gerrard's 'SPIRITS' artwork — Hawtin in a museum-plaza art context rather than a club, so expect something more textural and hypnotic than a peak-time techno hammer. Worth it for the name and the setting; RSVP required.
deede894fa33.description: Free summer-solstice dance at LACMA with a techno set from Richie Hawtin, tied to artist john gerrard's 'SPIRITS' installation.

artist_notes.name: Dave Harrington
artist_notes.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

artist_notes.name: John Dwyer
artist_notes.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

artist_notes.name: Spencer Zahn
artist_notes.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

artist_notes.name: Aaron Steele
artist_notes.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

artist_notes.name: Tom Dolas
artist_notes.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

e00ad8085b0c.curator_note: A one-off improvising quintet built around Dave Harrington (Darkside) and Oh Sees' John Dwyer at Zebulon — heady, psych-leaning instrumental jamming rather than songs. Squarely in the experimental-band lane Ari wants surfaced, and Zebulon's the perfect room for it.
e00ad8085b0c.description: One-night improvising quintet — Dave Harrington (Darkside), John Dwyer (Oh Sees), Aaron Steele, Spencer Zahn and Tom Dolas — at Zebulon in Frogtown.

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017, debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL. A tracked name on a proper North American DJ tour right now.

artist_notes.name: Alima Lee
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

9ea5376be5a4.curator_note: Lights Down Low doing what it does best: TBA location drops day-of, and they've booked Yaeji on a dedicated DJ-set summer tour — whispered-bilingual-house in a warehouse rather than a festival tent is the right format for her. Worth the address chase.
9ea5376be5a4.description: Lights Down Low presents Yaeji DJ set (plus Alima Lee, Hu Dat, AMERICANRECYCLING) at a location-TBA downtown warehouse, 10pm, 21+.

artist_notes.name: Adam Beyer
artist_notes.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno that anchors the darker half of this lineup. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house heavyweight (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s with 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab ('Nightmares'); reliable festival-circuit crowd-mover. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-German DJ born Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; evolved from hip-hop residencies to Space/Hi Ibiza residencies; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythm into house and tech house.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo
artist_notes.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has dropped on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno pitched between festival and underground.

artist_notes.name: Elderbrook
artist_notes.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' (CamelPhat collab, Grammy-nominated) made him; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act rather than a DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but a shade more radio-pop.

artist_notes.name: Sidepiece
artist_notes.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house rooted in Motown edits.

artist_notes.name: Westend
artist_notes.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped draft the modern American tech-house blueprint; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

artist_notes.name: Josh Baker
artist_notes.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy, fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project.

artist_notes.name: Riordan
artist_notes.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm, plus Black Book and Catch & Release.

artist_notes.name: Greg 99
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee; Insomniac Records debut.

bb4f346b7a87.curator_note: Day Trip's sixth Long Beach edition at the new Queen Mary Amphitheater is the tech-house festival LA actually needs — the Adam Beyer / Loco Dice / Hi-Lo block gives it real techno weight, and Cloonee headlining keeps it from disappearing up its own prog-house backside. Saturday is the day to go.
bb4f346b7a87.description: Day Trip Festival sixth edition at Queen Mary Waterfront, Long Beach — two-day house/techno/melodic fest with Adam Beyer, Cloonee, Loco Dice, Hi-Lo, Elderbrook, Hayden James, Sidepiece, Westend and 50+ others.

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse, ran Blackflag Recordings, and cut the acclaimed DJ-Kicks in 1996. Known aliases: Bango, Kosmik Messenger, Silent Phase. A tracked name bringing genuine Detroit lineage to this TBA night.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave. Sets move freely through Black diasporic club music: footwork, juke, breaks, R&B; a key figure in LA's queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Nish
artist_notes.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward, soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first curatorial approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

58579f941eb8.curator_note: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO have been landing Berghain-calibre bookings for years, and Stacey Pullen for a TBA late night is exactly that — second-wave Detroit in an intimate warehouse rather than a stage. BAE BAE warming up keeps the energy genuinely interesting rather than just competent.
58579f941eb8.description: Dirty Epic x INCOGNITO present Stacey Pullen (Detroit techno) alongside BAE BAE and Nish at a TBA Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm-4am, $25-30.

artist_notes.name: DJ Toka
artist_notes.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012, now at Exchange LA) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house, and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

3bb8aa27a866.curator_note: Sudamericana has been one of LA's most freewheeling Latin dance parties for over a decade — early 6pm start at Exchange LA, free with RSVP, and DJ Toka knows exactly how to move the room between cumbia, disco, and house without losing the floor.
3bb8aa27a866.description: Sudamericana monthly Latin house/disco party at Exchange LA, DTLA, with resident DJ Toka, 6pm, free with RSVP.

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator, M-Plant founder — co-founder of Underground Resistance alongside Jeff Mills and Mad Mike, then reduced the form to its bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). A tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno sets; hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

artist_notes.name: Ønyx
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the city's underground techno circuit; has an RA profile and plays the same WORK/INCOGNITO-adjacent events — limited wider footprint, included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio's earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

artist_notes.name: Jayda G
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ (Jacinda Gulley) — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul in her selections. Tracked name.

7e00f46a7221.curator_note: Sound is a proper room for Jayda G — she thrives in longer, sweatier sets where she can pull the floor through disco into gospel-house without hitting a hard stop. This is the July 4th pick if warehouse TBAs feel like too much admin.
7e00f46a7221.description: Jayda G (Ninja Tune) headlines Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — his stripped drum/bassline formula on 'Minimal Nation' (1994) is the blueprint for a significant chunk of modern techno. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ, dark and groovy underground techno; KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host.

artist_notes.name: Onyx
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno DJ; active on the WORK / Dirty Epic circuit. Limited wider footprint.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ — KCHUNG Radio earlyafters, Dirty Epic / WORK circuit regular. Dark, groovy sets.

e667ba3ea44d.curator_note: LA Discoteca is a recurring night at The Slipper Clutch doing what the name says — disco and house in a basement-y DTLA room. No headliner detail in the billing, so treat it as a low-effort add-on to a Friday that already has Yaeji or Stacey Pullen on it.
e667ba3ea44d.description: LA DISCOTECA recurring disco/house night at The Slipper Clutch, DTLA, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Enayet
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh using deep soundsystem pressure and South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh. Slippery, off-kilter club rhythms.

artist_notes.name: K Wata
artist_notes.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, also a SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; has produced for Yaeji and contributed to the james K remix album. The duo have played as E Wata together.

a2ec0d8dd081.curator_note: CSW (Costumed Suicide Watcher) and SLINK booking Enayet + K Wata all-night is a genuine curatorial swing — SLINK's whole thing is polyrhythmic club mutations that don't resolve neatly into any genre, which makes for unpredictable, genuinely interesting late nights. Different proposition from the Stacey Pullen or Robert Hood options on the same weekend.
a2ec0d8dd081.description: CSW and SLINK present Enayet and K Wata (SLINK, NYC) playing all night at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm, live/DJ.

artist_notes.name: discostan
artist_notes.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South and West Asian / North African music: 1980s disco, folkloric sounds, dancefloor re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW. One of a kind in LA.

da4e3fe70e19.curator_note: Discostan at El Cid is one of LA's genuinely singular recurring nights — Arshia Haq and crew weave SWANA folkloric music, '80s diaspora disco and re-edits into something no other promoter is doing in the city. Different enough from the house/techno lane to feel like a real discovery rather than a lateral move.
da4e3fe70e19.description: Discostan at El Cid, Silver Lake — the LA SWANA diaspora dance collective (Arshia Haq, co-founder) playing South/West Asian and North African disco, re-edits and folkloric dancefloor music, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Halo Varga
artist_notes.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owns Artifact Record Shop. House and techno with deep Chicago roots and a European finish.

artist_notes.name: Dylan Payne
artist_notes.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — soul-forward, all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

artist_notes.name: Highkin'
artist_notes.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

4b5718ac6609.curator_note: MARBLE runs proper Arts District afterhours — a 10pm-to-7am window with Halo Varga, one of fabric's original residents, at the top of the bill. 4b5718ac6609.description: MARBLE afterhours at a TBA Arts District location with Halo Varga (fabric/All Inn), Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar and more, 10pm-7am, $20-37.

artist_notes.name: Flying Mojito Bros
artist_notes.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda. Genuinely odd and fun in the right way.

artist_notes.name: Brainstory
artist_notes.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; live band performing at this Camille's date, not a DJ set. A bit outside the pure dance lane but with real groove DNA.

fd9f6e2edd10.curator_note: Flying Mojito Bros are a left-field booking for Camille's — their cosmic country-funk-to-acid-house sets are genuinely weird and don't fit a clean genre box, which tends to make for memorable nights. Brainstory are a live band so this is a hybrid show/club format; go for the FMB set if you want to dance.
fd9f6e2edd10.description: Flying Mojito Bros (cosmic disco/acid house, UK) and live soul-jazz act Brainstory at Camille's at The Bellwether, 9pm-2am, $24.

artist_notes.name: Ginger Root
artist_notes.note: Cameron Lew's solo project out of Huntington Beach — indie soul/alt-disco/boogie and Japanese city pop influences; his recordings are meticulously crafted handmade synth-pop. This is a DJ set appearance, not a live band show — expect disco, boogie, and city-pop records rather than his own material.

cf65e6d3a51e.curator_note: Ginger Root doing a DJ set at Camille's is a fun oddity — his music sits in the boogie/alt-disco zone and a free DJ night lets him play his influences rather than perform. Low commitment, free entry, and a nice change of pace from the heavier club nights on the same night.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ and Second State co-founder — hypnotic, peak-time techno; Factory 93 regular. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Charlotte de Witte
artist_notes.note: Belgian DJ, KNTXT founder — stripped, hard-hitting techno in the Berghain mold; one of the most consistently excellent techno headliners alive. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: DJ Seinfeld
artist_notes.note: Swedish-born Armand Jakobsson — lo-fi deep house and indie dance with emotional undertow; 'Love In Stereo' EP on Ninja Tune. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Mau P
artist_notes.note: Dutch DJ Maurits Colijn — crowd-moving tech-house ('Drums Please', 'Your Mind Is Dirty') at the mainstream/underground crossover. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house/tech-house producer Lukas Ruiz — polished melodic house with streaming mega-numbers; Canja Audio Culture label boss. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Chris Lorenzo
artist_notes.note: Birmingham-raised UK producer — playful, bass-heavy tech house and 4x4 with '80s sample palette. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Anetha
artist_notes.note: French techno DJ/producer, Mama Told Ya label founder — dark, hypnotic sets with a distinctly European grain; Berghain resident.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: German-Iraqi producer Alex Ridha, Boysnoize Records founder — electro-tinged techno with hip-hop DNA; co-wrote Lady Gaga's Grammy-winning 'Rain on Me'.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ Martyna Maja — industrial EBM, acid and sped-up trance blended into relentless high-speed techno; Repitch and Ninja Tune catalogue.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ Tiga Sontag, Turbo Recordings founder — sharp, ironic electro-house and techno; launched Chromeo and Gesaffelstein on his label.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Cuban-American DJ Eric Estornel, Ellum Audio founder — bridges melodic techno, house and electro with a Miami-rooted sensibility.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester-born DJ Zachary Bruce — UK garage/speed garage revivalist; co-founded ATW Records; 'BOTA' with Eliza Rose went UK #1.

artist_notes.name: Luuk van Dijk
artist_notes.note: Amsterdam DJ/producer — Hot Creations, VIVa Music and his own Dark Side Of The Sun; contemporary tech-house with old-school warmth.

artist_notes.name: Brutalismus 3000
artist_notes.note: Berlin duo Victoria Daldas and Theo Zeitner — nu-gabber, post-punk techno with hardcore and EBM edges; collab with Boys Noize on 2026 LP 'Harmony'.

4dd13aaa260f.curator_note: The RA-picked day of HARD Summer packs more genuine underground credibility than the festival usually gets — Charlotte de Witte and Amelie Lens anchoring the main techno block alongside DJ Seinfeld and Mau P means you can spend the whole day at one or two stages without compromising. Bring patience for the Inglewood logistics.
4dd13aaa260f.description: HARD Summer Music Festival Day 1 at Hollywood Park Grounds, a two-day outdoor festival featuring Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, DJ Seinfeld, Mau P, Vintage Culture, Tiga, and 50+ others across multiple stages.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ and Second State co-founder (with Pan-Pot) — hypnotic, peak-time techno with a driving, hypnotic quality; Factory 93 and Exhale-label regular. Tracked name.

d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: Factory 93 bringing Amelie Lens to Grand Park DTLA for an RA-picked open-air set is exactly the kind of free-spirited outdoor techno date that makes this city work — she's playing at the height of her powers right now. Worth the Sat-night commitment.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents Amelie Lens at Grand Park Block 2 in DTLA, a ticketed outdoor techno event starting at 5pm.

artist_notes.name: Empire of the Sun
artist_notes.note: Australian electronic duo Luke Steele and Nick Littlemore — theatrical, costume-heavy synth-pop; 'Walking on a Dream' was a global hit; touring their 2024 LP 'Ask That God: Afterlife'.

artist_notes.name: Polo & Pan
artist_notes.note: Parisian duo Paul Armand-Delille and Alexandre Grynszpan — tropical-tinted French house, electropop and disco; 'Ani Kuni' their biggest recent hit. Spotify core rotation here.

artist_notes.name: Midnight Generation
artist_notes.note: Support act on this tour; limited verified public profile — included per the billing.

c24037cc642d.curator_note: The Bowl is the right room for Empire of the Sun's theatrical, costumed spectacle — this is peak-production pop-electronic, not a club night, and Polo & Pan as direct support makes the evening genuinely strong before the headliner. Worth it for the setting alone.
c24037cc642d.description: Empire of the Sun's 'Ask That God: Afterlife' North American Tour at Hollywood Bowl with Polo & Pan and Midnight Generation as support.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ and Second State co-founder — hypnotic peak-time techno. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house/tech-house producer Lukas Ruiz — polished melodic house, streaming juggernaut. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ Tiga Sontag, Turbo Recordings founder — sharp electro-house and techno that launched Chromeo and Gesaffelstein.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ Martyna Maja — industrial EBM, acid and sped-up trance into relentless techno; Repitch and Ninja Tune catalogue.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: German-Iraqi producer Alex Ridha — electro-tinged techno with hip-hop DNA; Boysnoize Records boss.

52241f8a3d48.curator_note: Day 2 of HARD has a slightly lighter tracklist than Day 1 — Amelie Lens returns, Vintage Culture anchors the commercial house side, and VTSS is the most interesting wildcard. If you have both days, Saturday is the stronger pick; if it's just Sunday, the lineup still justifies going.
52241f8a3d48.description: HARD Summer Music Festival Day 2 at Hollywood Park Grounds, featuring Amelie Lens, Vintage Culture, Tiga, VTSS, Boys Noize, Andy C, and 15+ others.

artist_notes.name: Overmono
artist_notes.note: Welsh duo Tom Russell (Truss) and Ed Russell (Tessela) — hard-edged yet melodic UK rave and bass music on XL Recordings; 'Good Lies' LP brought them from the underground to festival mainstage. Tracked name.

edab80bd44cb.curator_note: Overmono's live show is a proper rave disguised as a concert — the brothers bring the hardware and the Palladium is the right size room before they inevitably headline a stage. The 'Vinyl Room' pre-party opening at 6:30 is a nice bonus if you get there early.
edab80bd44cb.description: Overmono live (Pure Devotion World Tour) at Hollywood Palladium, with a Vinyl Room pre-party opening at 6:30pm and main doors at 8pm (18+).

artist_notes.name: Sacha Robotti
artist_notes.note: Italian-German-Belgian-raised Dirtybird mainstay since 2012, Slothacid founder — hypnotic, deep-bass tech house with a playful Ibiza edge.

artist_notes.name: Ardalan
artist_notes.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house from the Sunset Sound System lineage.

21135e84e3da.curator_note: A Dirtybird road-to-Campout rooftop at Level 8 is a solid pre-4th setup — Sacha Robotti and Ardalan know exactly how to make an afternoon pool party feel like a proper set rather than background music. $30 pre is fair for a 6-hour run in the sun.
21135e84e3da.description: Dirtybird x FLOAT 'Road to Campout' rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA with Sacha Robotti and Ardalan, 2–8pm, $30 pre.

00bfe8a0d235.curator_note: Sparse billing — 'GG (5)' on RA with no lineup detail makes this hard to verify. Townhouse Venice is a bar venue, the afterhours flag is the draw, but without a confirmed lineup it's a low-conviction pick on a crowded 4th of July weekend.
00bfe8a0d235.description: Late-night afterhours electronic party 'Good Game' at Townhouse in Venice, 10pm.

089c71f526eb.curator_note: An anime-cosplay rave at Dave and Busters is a long way from the lane — no lineup, organizer 'Ledisko Nights' has no verifiable track record. Filed under 'something is happening' rather than a real recommendation.
089c71f526eb.description: Anime/gaming cosplay rave party hosted by Ledisko Nights at Dave and Busters, 10pm, free.

84180a2db7a4.curator_note: A free 4th of July rooftop party at Level 8 from organizer DREAMBASH — no lineup billed, which makes it a social occasion rather than a music pick. The venue is right (you love the rooftop) but the billing is too thin to recommend over confirmed lineups this weekend.
84180a2db7a4.description: DREAMBASH '4th of July' rooftop party at Level 8 DTLA, 9pm, free.

9fd90f37b8e7.description: 'The Roamers' event at The Redwood Bar and Grill in DTLA, 8pm.

artist_notes.name: LA Riots
artist_notes.note: LA-based production duo — tech-house and bass-house; Beatport-charting club cuts and festival circuit bookings.

b0174ef2b3e9.curator_note: A $10 late-night tech-house/deep-house underground at Los Globos in Silver Lake — practically in your backyard and priced right. LA Riots is the most recognizable name; the bill (Beast, Jacz, Lavenge, Max Rush) reads like a solid local underground rotation rather than a marquee booking.
b0174ef2b3e9.description: Recollect Underground presents LA Riots, Beast, Jacz, Lavenge and Max Rush at Los Globos in Silver Lake, 11pm–5am, $10 pre (tech-house, deep house, minimal).

artist_notes.name: Lee Burridge
artist_notes.note: British DJ and All Day I Dream founder — invented 'organic house' (slower BPMs, hand drums, acoustic textures); his outdoor daytime format is exactly the rooftop-groove equivalent done properly.

artist_notes.name: Radio Slave
artist_notes.note: British producer/DJ Matt Edwards — Rekids co-founder; propulsive, muscular house and techno; also records as Cabin Fever and The Machine.

artist_notes.name: Justin Martin
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird co-founder out of San Francisco — melodic-but-tough house with emotional depth; also runs the What To Do... imprint.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: LA house legend since the late '80s — Sublevel Records founder; deep house, acid, tribal and classics; a foundational West Coast selector.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: DJ Colette
artist_notes.note: Chicago house vocalist and DJ, SmartBar resident — classically trained mezzo-soprano who sings over her own deep house sets; 25+ years in the scene.

artist_notes.name: Mikey Lion
artist_notes.note: San Diego-born DJ and Desert Hearts co-founder — the hippy/rave underground end of US house and techno; Desert Hearts Records launched free in 2014.

artist_notes.name: DAVI
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer David Alvarado — deep, refined house and techno on Crosstown Rebels and Naked Lunch; co-runs the Long Island Electrical Systems series.

86ca88c4e980.curator_note: Love Long Beach has assembled a genuinely deep bill — Lee Burridge's All Day I Dream format outdoors, Radio Slave, DJ Minx, DJ Colette, and Doc Martin in his own city. It's Long Beach rather than Silver Lake, but this lineup justifies the drive more than most weekend festivals.
86ca88c4e980.description: Love Long Beach Festival 2026 at Shoreline Aquatic Park — a daytime outdoor house and techno festival featuring Lee Burridge, Radio Slave, DJ Minx, Justin Martin, Doc Martin, DJ Colette, Mikey Lion, DAVI and others.

artist_notes.name: Taylor Shockley
artist_notes.note: LA-based vinyl selector — deep house and disco edits, active on the downtown underground all-vinyl circuit.

artist_notes.name: Luke Mele
artist_notes.note: LA selector on the downtown underground vinyl circuit; limited wider public footprint.

artist_notes.name: CHÓICE
artist_notes.note: Listed on the RA billing for this all-vinyl DTLA night; limited verified public profile — included per the billing.

9a0fd9893571.curator_note: TBA-location afterhours all-vinyl night from the Information crew — the format (house and disco off real wax, no laptop, unknown space) is exactly what you want at 10pm on a Friday. Limited billing details but the all-vinyl flag and late-night format make it worth tracking.
9a0fd9893571.description: Information presents an all-vinyl afterhours night with Taylor Shockley, Luke Mele and CHÓICE at a TBA Downtown LA location, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Demuir
artist_notes.note: Toronto producer/DJ — self-described creator of the Jackin House genre on Beatport; Hammond B3-influenced soulful house; Hot Creations and his own Purveyor Underground imprint.

0eb89ce23c2b.curator_note: Certified Groovers landing Demuir for a TBA-location afterhours is a strong pull — he's the Toronto equivalent of a Hot Creations lifer, groovy and funky without being lightweight. Same HARD Summer weekend means a lot of people will be at Inglewood, which could make this more intimate than usual.
0eb89ce23c2b.description: Certified Groovers presents Toronto's Demuir at a TBA Downtown LA location, afterhours from 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Puglia-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer — Berghain resident; eclectic blend of house, electro-disco and techno on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton and his own Funnuvojere imprint; a genuinely European deep-selection pick.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (Midnight Lovers crew, NTS, Dublab) — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector associated with the Midnight Lovers orbit — deep house and disco-leaning sets; limited wider public footprint.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Pagliara at The Bridge is a rare LA booking for a genuine Berghain insider — his sets run from Ostgut Ton techno textures into electro-disco without ever losing the thread. The Midnight Lovers crew sets the room up right. A Friday night worth moving things around for.
8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers presents Massimiliano Pagliara (Berlin/Berghain) with Masha Mar and James Axon at The Bridge in DTLA, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: SOFI TUKKER
artist_notes.note: NYC duo Sophie Hawley-Weld and Tucker Halpern — tropical-inflected dance-pop and house with Brazilian vocal layers and West African percussion DNA; Grammy-nominated for 'Drinkee'. Spotify core rotation act.

artist_notes.name: DRAMA
artist_notes.note: Chicago R&B/electronic duo Na'el Shehade (producer) and Via Rosa (vocalist) — debut LP 'Dance Without Me' on Ghostly International; soulful, jazz-tinged club music at the R&B/dance crossover.

48e360ba751a.curator_note: Sofi Tukker at the Greek is a great-venue-plus-fun-act evening rather than a landmark club-music event — their live show is genuinely energetic and the Brazilian-percussion-meets-house formula holds up outdoors. DRAMA as support is the most interesting element for the lane.
48e360ba751a.description: Sofi Tukker live at the Greek Theatre, Los Feliz, with Chicago R&B/electronic duo DRAMA as support, 7:30pm.

artist_notes.name: ORLOVE
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/selector Orlovebynight — runs Midnite City, an indie-disco night at The Moroccan; spins the electronic-indie crossover: Justice, LCD Soundsystem, Daft Punk, Soulwax, Crystal Castles edits.

cf044cb77173.curator_note: The Moroccan Lounge is the right small-room for what Midnite City is doing — indie-electronic crossover (LCD, Disclosure, Justice, Daft Punk) in a friendly non-pretentious setting. A low-stakes, cheap Friday that doesn't compete with the bigger rooms and is better for it.
cf044cb77173.description: Midnite City: Indie Disco DJ night at The Moroccan Lounge, Arts District, hosted by ORLOVE — expect Justice, LCD Soundsystem, Daft Punk, Hot Chip and similar indie-electronic crossover, 9:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: California-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer and Limousine Dream label founder — lush, patient deep house that earns its running time; a Boiler Room favourite.

3061917831bd.curator_note: Gene On Earth playing afterhours for Certified Groovers is the kind of TBA-location late-night booking that rewards commitment — his sets are long, patient and deeply rooted in the groove-house tradition you're after. Same night as Overmono at the Palladium means you'd have to pick one.
3061917831bd.description: Certified Groovers presents Gene On Earth (Limousine Dream, Berlin) for an afterhours set at a TBA Downtown LA location, from 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Collin Reeve
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the Certified Groovers underground circuit — deep, groove-oriented house and techno; regular TBA-location warehouse bookings.

artist_notes.name: MXM
artist_notes.note: LA DJ billed on the Certified Groovers circuit; limited wider public footprint — included per the billing.

2e5710a4c036.curator_note: The Certified Groovers series consistently books the underground right, and a 10pm-7am all-night format from Collin Reeve and MXM is exactly the kind of pre-holiday midnight deep-run worth penciling in at $17. No marquee name, but the track record of the series is the signal.
2e5710a4c036.description: Certified Groovers presents Collin Reeve and MXM for an all-night set (10pm–7am) at a TBA Downtown LA location, $17.15.

artist_notes.name: Pan-Pot
artist_notes.note: Berlin duo Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix — Second State founders (home to Amelie Lens, Luigi Madonna, Perc); driving minimal-techno from two decades of Berghain residency.

artist_notes.name: DOOSTAH
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the 6AM/Synthetik Minds circuit — techno and minimal; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Kitty Logic
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ in the WORK/6AM orbit — techno; limited wider public footprint, included per the billing.

b4799df0eb5f.curator_note: Pan-Pot doing a 4-hour set in a TBA-location LA warehouse for WORK is as good as the underground techno calendar gets here — the Second State co-founders know how to work a room across an extended set, and the RA pick is warranted. This is the one to build the 4th of July weekend around.
b4799df0eb5f.description: WORK presents Berlin techno duo Pan-Pot in a special 4-hour set at a TBA Los Angeles location, afterhours from 11pm–6am; $30 before midnight (RA pick).

4812141a4770.description: Abstract brings their international hard techno brand to 1720 Arts District with resident NEEK alongside Estonian techno fixture Merimell and LA-based hard techno live act DEA MAGNA, 10pm-4am.

artist_notes.name: NEEK
artist_notes.note: Southern California-based DJ/producer who blew up fast in the hard techno lane through viral social content and aggressive industrial-edged edits — organizer and resident for the Abstract LA series.

artist_notes.name: DEA MAGNA
artist_notes.note: LA-based live act — classically trained pianist who fuses hard techno and trance with her own vocals; releases on Reinier Zonneveld's Filth on Acid and Revealed. The live-singing-over-drum-machines format is her signature.

artist_notes.name: Merimell
artist_notes.note: Estonian techno pioneer and Machine Nation founder — one of the first women in her country's techno scene; releases on Killekill (Berlin) and Desolat-adjacent labels; sets lean hard, fast and uncompromising.

4812141a4770.curator_note: Hard techno and trance-industrial at full volume — Abstract runs a serious international circuit but this is squarely the harder-faster end that sits outside the house/groove lane. Worth flagging as a late-night option for when you want punishment over selection.

f7ba57f98f38.description: Insomniac's Mutate series at Exchange LA hosts Kayzo (Hayden Capuozzo), an LA-based genre-blender known for fusing hardstyle, dubstep, trap and electronic rock, 10pm-3am.

artist_notes.name: Kayzo
artist_notes.note: LA-based producer (Hayden Capuozzo) who won Insomniac's Discovery Project in 2012 — builds sets by colliding hardstyle, dubstep, trap and rock-inflected bass music; founder of Welcome Records. Firmly the festival-bass end of the spectrum, not the house lane.

f7ba57f98f38.curator_note: Kayzo is hardstyle-meets-dubstep-meets-electronic-rock — a big-room bass festival act rather than anything in the house or groove lane. Insomniac's Mutate series is the right home for it, but this isn't the night if groove and selection are what you're after.

7075782b1841.description: Soul Source LA's monthly party at The Airliner in Lincoln Heights, co-founded by blksoap — an eclectic, inclusive dance night moving through house, hip-hop, neo-soul and R&B, 9pm-2am.

artist_notes.name: blksoap
artist_notes.note: LA-born, Bay Area-based DJ and co-founder of Soul Source LA — eclectic underground selector moving through house, hip-hop, jazz and R&B; also founded the Textures party series and teaches in the Bay Area.

artist_notes.name: Kobie Dozier
artist_notes.note: LA/NYC saxophonist, composer and creative producer — performer and curator who has taken his 'For The People' tour across both cities; brings live musicianship energy into the DJ context.

artist_notes.name: Roxswift
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector on the Soul Source / local underground circuit; limited wider public profile, included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Duma
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the Soul Source circuit; limited wider public profile, included on billing confidence.

7075782b1841.curator_note: Soul Source is one of the better community-driven nights on the eastside — blksoap's selections are genuinely eclectic and the Airliner room keeps it unpretentious. The saxophonist/composer angle with Kobie Dozier adds something live bands nights sometimes lose when they go full DJ. Good $8 Friday if Zebulon is sold out.

be4939188e8d.description: Amore Rooftop Party at Jade Beverly Hills — afro house from 4pm through an afterparty stretch to 2am, with Shanto, Perstephanii, Luigi Amore and Amina Jaguar; free before 6pm with RSVP.

artist_notes.name: Shanto
artist_notes.note: LA-based underground selector with broad range from downtempo to techno and deep to indie — active in the city's afro house and deep house circuits.

artist_notes.name: Perstephanii
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the local afro house circuit, often billed alongside Shanto; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Amina Jaguar
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and vocalist on the afro house circuit; limited verifiable detail beyond local billings.

be4939188e8d.curator_note: Beverly Hills isn't the usual spot for an afro house rooftop but free RSVP before 6pm and a four-hour run-up to the afterparty makes this a low-risk afternoon option if you want the BH skyline with some Black Coffee energy underneath it.

546af0d5d5dd.description: A24's new comedy 'The Invite' (2026, dir. Olivia Wilde) at the Vista Theater — Seth Rogen and Penélope Cruz star in a dinner-party-gone-sideways comedy; 93% on Rotten Tomatoes.
546af0d5d5dd.curator_note: A24 dark comedy directed by and starring Olivia Wilde, with Seth Rogen and Penélope Cruz — the Vista is the right room for it, and 93% on RT in its opening week suggests this isn't just marketing hype. The 7:30pm show is the civilized start to a Friday.

a58abde6a6b3.description: Spielberg's Jaws (1975) at the Vista Theater in Los Feliz — midnight screening of the summer-blockbuster-that-invented-summer-blockbusters.
a58abde6a6b3.curator_note: Jaws at midnight on a Friday at the Vista is exactly how you're supposed to see it — massive screen, full crowd, John Williams building in a dark room. If you're done early at a DJ night or skipping the clubs altogether, this is a perfect cap.

cf125d4c9e8e.description: NIGHTSHIFT After Hours at The Lexington Bar DTLA — recurring underground house afterhours by the Blind Tiger collective, secret lineup, 11pm-5am, free RSVP before 1am.
cf125d4c9e8e.curator_note: Blind Tiger runs one of DTLA's more dependable afterhours formats — no flash photography, no song requests, house all night in a bar-sized room that self-selects for people who actually want to dance. Free before 1am means no commitment.

1fc49d028590.description: Dan O'Bannon's Return of the Living Dead (1985) at the Vista Theater — the zombie-punk-comedy that gave us 'BRAAAINS' screaming and a soundtrack of 45 Grave and The Cramps.
1fc49d028590.curator_note: Return of the Living Dead is legitimately great — fast, funny, with a killer punk soundtrack and the exact kind of midnight-movie energy a Friday night deserves. Better than most things playing at the clubs at the same hour.

35b87fd7a989.description: NIGHTSHIFT's free AFTERS at 129 E 3rd St (The Lexington), DTLA — same promoter, same address as the NIGHTSHIFT After Hours listing; free entry.
35b87fd7a989.curator_note: This appears to be the same Lexington afterhours as the NIGHTSHIFT listing under a different entry — same address (129 E 3rd), same organizer, same format. Verify before buying anything; the free Posh link is the ticket.

8d222acf28bc.description: Midnight Lovers Day & Night party at The Bridge, DTLA — New York house and disco vet Eli Escobar plays 7pm-2am on July 4th, $22 advance.

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

8d222acf28bc.curator_note: Eli Escobar going seven hours at The Bridge on the Fourth is the kind of long-format groove option that doesn't need fireworks to justify itself — he's one of New York's most genuinely versatile selectors and the Midnight Lovers context suits him. Solid alternative to the warehouse TBAs.

47a5f0b8c04a.description: Stereo Punks and Orlove By Day co-present Australian producer Young Franco for a 4th of July pool party at Level 8 DTLA, 2pm, $20.

artist_notes.name: Young Franco
artist_notes.note: Brisbane-born producer (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — ARIA-Gold-certified with 'Drop Your Love'; blends disco, funk, house and indie pop; debut LP 'It's Franky Baby' (2025). Festival-ready but with genuine groove DNA, not empty festival-tech-house.

47a5f0b8c04a.curator_note: Young Franco is better than his festival-billing suggests — his disco and funk instincts keep the pool-party format from going full generic tech-house. The Level 8 rooftop in July is exactly the right context, and the Orlove/Stereo Punks pairing adds some curatorial credibility to the bill.

5797c554d79b.description: Paradisco monthly disco/house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (The Line Hotel, Koreatown) with Nica on the decks, 10pm-2am, free.

artist_notes.name: Nica
artist_notes.note: DJ on the Paradisco/Kiss Kiss Bang Bang circuit; limited wider public profile — included on billing confidence. Paradisco is the regular resident series at this venue.

5797c554d79b.curator_note: Paradisco is a solid disco-house monthly at one of LA's better dressed rooms — the KKBB checkered floor and '70s-deco setting are half the appeal. No deep headliner this edition, but it's free and the format is consistent if you want dressed-up disco without the Koreatown bottle-service clubs nearby.

61428e90f126.description: TECHTONIK presents OKAYVAL's LA headline show at a TBA DTLA warehouse, with XVIRAD, Silvertone (US) and JACZ — hard-edged tech-house and acid techno, 11:45pm.

artist_notes.name: OKAYVAL
artist_notes.note: Colombian-born, Jacksonville-based DJ/producer — rising fast in the tech-house and hard techno crossover space; tracks on Insomniac Records; known for dark grooves and heavy basslines.

artist_notes.name: XVIRAD
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the DTLA underground techno/house circuit; appears on the TECHTONIK and local warehouse billing. Limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Silvertone (US)
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-based house DJ/producer — works across minimal tech, bass house and acid techno; active on the secret-warehouse circuit.

artist_notes.name: JACZ
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the DTLA warehouse underground circuit; included on billing confidence, limited verifiable wider profile.

61428e90f126.curator_note: OKAYVAL is gaining momentum in the darker tech-house/acid-techno lane — more serious than the name might suggest, and the TBA-warehouse format keeps the room right. Worth tracking if you want to catch her before the CRSSD bookings hit.

fc7159a30596.description: Club Cielo's 4th of July femme-DJ takeover at El Cid, Silver Lake — guaracha, baile funk, tribal and Latin club sounds with KEBRA (CDMX/Brazil), Linapary (Colombia/Madrid), QUEENIE (US) and DINABN, 10pm-2am.

artist_notes.name: Linapary
artist_notes.note: Colombian DJ and producer based in Madrid — one of the rising voices in alter-perreo and guaracha; sets mix guaracha, tribal, baile funk and perreo with femme/queer politics baked in. Has played Whole Festival Berlin, Rinse France, La Machine Paris.

artist_notes.name: KEBRA
artist_notes.note: DJ/producer from CDMX/Brazil on the Club Cielo bill — Latin club and guaracha selector; limited public profile beyond this circuit.

artist_notes.name: DINABN
artist_notes.note: DJ behind the Club Cielo series at El Cid — resident curator setting the guaracha/tribal/Latin club format for the night; LA-based.

artist_notes.name: QUEENIE (US)
artist_notes.note: US-based DJ on the Club Cielo bill; limited public profile beyond this Latin club circuit.

fc7159a30596.curator_note: Club Cielo is doing something specific — guaracha and alter-perreo through a femme and queer lens, which puts it well outside the house/techno lane but makes it genuinely singular in LA on any given night. Linapary is the one to watch; she's a legitimate force in European Latin club scenes.

18606901dd64.description: The LA Raver x Techtonik present OKAYVAL, Silvertone, XVIRAD and JACZ at a TBA DTLA location — techno, acid techno and house, 11:45pm, free entry.

artist_notes.name: OKAYVAL
artist_notes.note: Colombian-born DJ/producer rising in the dark tech-house and acid techno space — Insomniac Records releases, dark grooves and heavy basslines.

artist_notes.name: Silvertone (US)
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-based house/techno DJ — minimal tech, acid techno and bass house across the US warehouse circuit.

artist_notes.name: XVIRAD
artist_notes.note: LA-based underground DJ on the DTLA warehouse circuit; limited wider public footprint.

artist_notes.name: JACZ
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the DTLA warehouse circuit; included on billing confidence.

18606901dd64.curator_note: This reads as the same event as the TECHTONIK-presented OKAYVAL headline show — same artists, same date and approximate time, different promoter branding and a 'free' price tag vs. $7.81 on the other listing. Check the Posh link to confirm before committing; one is likely the pre-sale, the other door.

d2c2365c2419.description: Trinity and WA$TED co-present DRAKK and TRIPTYKH at 1720 Warehouse — a 4th of July schranz/hard techno night, 9pm-2am, 18+.

artist_notes.name: TRIPTYKH
artist_notes.note: Dallas-based hard techno DJ and Klangkuenstler signee — Beatport's leading US purveyor of schranz; debut 'Unholy' EP hit #1 on the all-genre Beatport EP chart. The name in this lineup if you're going for schranz over selection.

artist_notes.name: DRAKK
artist_notes.note: US-based hard techno DJ/producer — active on BeatStats' hard techno top-20 list; limited wider public footprint beyond the hard techno circuit.

d2c2365c2419.curator_note: Hard techno/schranz through and through — TRIPTYKH is genuinely one of the better US acts in that lane, but this is the battering-ram end of the spectrum rather than anything in the groove or house vein. For the crowd that wants BPMs over 140 and nothing else.

38704e425435.description: Trip to Ibiza and Lifted Events present Adam Auburn with Rozzwell and DVYN at Golden Hour, Level 8 DTLA — tech house, deep house and minimal in an open-air rooftop setting, 8pm-midnight, $10 before 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Adam Auburn
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and Traxsource competition winner (2004) with an Insomniac-circuit pedigree — has played alongside Louie Vega, Hot Since 82, Derrick Carter and John Digweed; works the tech-house and deep-house spectrum. A Level 8 / Golden Hour regular.

artist_notes.name: Rozzwell
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector on the Golden Hour / Trip to Ibiza circuit; limited wider public profile beyond local billings.

artist_notes.name: DVYN
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the Golden Hour circuit; included on billing confidence, limited verifiable public profile.

38704e425435.curator_note: This is the Level 8 rooftop formula — tech house and deep house over the DTLA skyline at sunset, with a Ibiza-leaning vibe that doesn't pretend to be underground. Adam Auburn has the credentials to back up the format, and $10 before 9pm is an easy in.

3811f57ad3ce.description: Spielberg's Jaws (1975) midnight screening at the Vista Theater, Los Feliz — the same late Friday/Saturday format as the July 3 showing, second chance if you missed it.
3811f57ad3ce.curator_note: Second night of the Vista's Jaws midnight run — same film, same room, same logic as Thursday. If you're out anyway and the clubs haven't clicked, this is the best fallback on either side of midnight.

504fdfb0c59d.description: A24's 'The Invite' (2026, dir. Olivia Wilde) continues at the Vista Theater, Los Feliz — second day of the run for the dinner-party comedy starring Seth Rogen, Penélope Cruz and Edward Norton.
504fdfb0c59d.curator_note: The July 4th matinee or early-evening option at the Vista — 'The Invite' seems like the kind of thing that works better with an actual audience reaction than on a streaming platform later. The 7pm show keeps the whole night open.

98fdda61ec68.description: NIGHTSHIFT After Hours at The Lexington Bar DTLA — July 4th edition of the recurring Blind Tiger collective underground house afterhours, secret lineup, 11pm.
98fdda61ec68.curator_note: The Fourth of July version of NIGHTSHIFT is probably busier than usual given the holiday weekend, which cuts both ways — the room is lively but the self-selecting underground format tends to hold regardless. No lineup announced, so it's a roll of the dice.

f3d009a49a15.curator_note: JSTA's July 4th party at Porter Street Studios — the Downtown arts-district warehouse space. No lineup detail in the record, so hard to call the music quality, but the organizer has a history of house-focused events. At $5 it's a free-roll if you're already in that part of town.
f3d009a49a15.description: JSTA promoter's 4th of July afternoon party at Porter Street Studios, DTLA, from 3pm, $5.

13cbe6748424.curator_note: Inland Groove's Fourth of July edition — free entry, DTLA, 6pm start. The organizer runs consistent house-forward nights, but no lineup has been announced. Worth monitoring; at free you can walk in and make your own call on the music.
13cbe6748424.description: Inland Groove promoter's free 4th of July house party in DTLA, starting 6pm.

ed1f3766f0b5.curator_note: NIGHTSHIFT's free afterhours at 129 E 3rd St on the Fourth — no DJs announced in the record, which is pretty standard for a last-minute July 4th afterhours. The address is a fixed DTLA space, not a TBA chase. Free entry makes it an easy landing strip.
ed1f3766f0b5.description: NIGHTSHIFT promoter's free 4th of July afterhours at 129 E 3rd St, DTLA, starting 11pm.

b6852c8ebf6c.title_ref: DANI THORNE 4TH OF JULY HARD TECHNO

artist_notes.name: Dani Thorne
artist_notes.note: LA-based hard techno DJ/producer — draws from Nico Moreno, Sara Landry and Brutalismus 3000; big mainstage presence (EDC, Ultra, Lollapalooza); 600k+ social following. Her sets lean raw and industrial rather than refined European techno. More festival-scale energy than the underground end of the taste profile.

b6852c8ebf6c.curator_note: Dani Thorne is genuinely talented but her lane is the heavy, high-BPM end of American hard techno — the kind that goes big on mainstages rather than Berghain basements. At $8 and secret-location DTLA on the Fourth it's a low-stakes option if you want something pounding after midnight, not the refined European techno you'd usually chase.
b6852c8ebf6c.description: CLIMAX Events presents LA hard techno DJ Dani Thorne at a secret DTLA location, midnight July 4th, $8.

469750d25f5c.title_ref: Day Trip In The Park LA: Hayden James, Gudfella, Local Singles

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You', Gorgon City collab); RÜFÜS Du Sol-adjacent but a shade more radio-pop. Future Classic signee. Reliable big outdoor-format draw.

artist_notes.name: GUDFELLA
artist_notes.note: Philippines-born, LA-based DJ/producer Kyle Domingo — melodic and pop-adjacent house with 113M+ streams; 'Morning Coffee' and a Tiësto collab put him on festival maps; played Coachella 2026. Brighter and more radio-facing than the underground end of the taste.

artist_notes.name: Local Singles
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer on the Day Trip circuit; limited verified profile beyond local/circuit bookings.

469750d25f5c.curator_note: Day Trip's July 5th outdoor edition is the melodic/pop-house counterpoint to the weekend's warehouse options — Hayden James is genuinely good at this format and the daytime park setting suits him. Not the underground-groove lane, but a well-produced open-air option if you want a proper afternoon out.
469750d25f5c.description: Day Trip In The Park: an afternoon outdoor house event at LA State Historic Park featuring Hayden James, GUDFELLA and Local Singles, 2pm-8:30pm, $37.

f072162cd85c.curator_note: KNKT.'s open-air DTLA afterhours on July 5th — free, location TBA, 10pm start. No lineup announced, which is a recurring pattern with this organizer. The 'open-air' tag is the hook; if it pans out it's a good late-Sunday option, but hold off until the address drops and DJs are announced.
f072162cd85c.description: KNKT. promoter's free open-air afterhours party at a TBA DTLA location, July 5, 10pm.

152ca22ba09c.title_ref: Cirra presents: Day Thief, Faited, and sosoftly

artist_notes.name: Day Thief
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ whose RA profile traces back to 2019; active on the city's underground circuit. Plays across house and electronic; limited wider verifiable profile beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Faited
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer on the local underground circuit; no verified label or broad profile found — included per billing.

artist_notes.name: David Le Brun
artist_notes.note: Listed in the lineup data; no verified artist profile found under this name in the electronic music context.

152ca22ba09c.curator_note: Cirra is a local DTLA promoter running TBA-location nights with local selectors — no marquee names here, but the RA listing and afterhours format suggest it's genuinely aimed at dancers rather than a casual crowd. Low-commitment option on a Friday if nothing else has your attention.
152ca22ba09c.description: Cirra promoter presents a late-night electronic party with Day Thief, Faited (sosoftly) and David Le Brun at a TBA Downtown LA location, 10pm.

f9740e4e2ca2.title_ref: Great Quality Entertainment presents Township Rebellion with Trou and DENYC

artist_notes.name: Township Rebellion
artist_notes.note: German duo Arthur Wagner and Marlon Mürle, founded 2012 — rose on Stil vor Talent, then breakthrough on RÜFÜS Du Sol's Rose Avenue after a headline Burning Man set; now on Factory 93, HILOMATIK and Truesoul. Melodic, atmosphere-heavy progressive techno with a festival-circuit audience; played EDC, Drumsheds, Electric Forest.

f9740e4e2ca2.curator_note: Township Rebellion are one of the cleaner European-melodic bookings to come through 1720 this summer — the Stil vor Talent / Rose Avenue orbit is real Afterlife-adjacent territory without the inflated Afterlife ticket prices. The warehouse setting at 1720 suits their sound better than an outdoor stage.
f9740e4e2ca2.description: Great Quality Entertainment presents German melodic techno duo Township Rebellion at 1720 in the Arts District with Trou and DENYC, 10pm-3am, $21.

6f32f9cbcf9b.curator_note: Kevin Costner's 1990 western epic at the Vista — three hours plus of Plains frontier immersion, and the Vista's big single-screen is genuinely the right room for the scope of it. Good Friday pick if you want something that fills a whole evening without going out.
6f32f9cbcf9b.description: Repertory screening of Kevin Costner's 'Dances With Wolves' (1990, 181 min) at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, 8pm.

f198ba14b87d.curator_note: A midnight slot at the Vista on a Friday — 'Hollywood 90028' is a 1973 exploitation-horror set in the film industry; the kind of thing the Vista programs for the cult crowd. If you're into the midnight-movie circuit, this is the move; otherwise, skip for the Dances With Wolves earlier in the evening.
f198ba14b87d.description: Late-night cult screening of 'Hollywood 90028' (1973 exploitation thriller) at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, midnight.

artist_notes.name: Porter Robinson
artist_notes.note: Highly produced melodic bass / future-house — household name, not annotated in detail. His 'Virtual Self' alias does harder club-adjacent material but this is a DJ set at his own-branded festival.

5b8636a94da3.curator_note: Lost in Dreams is Insomniac's future-bass festival and this is very much Porter Robinson's personal sound rather than anything close to house or techno — lush melodic drops, emotional builds, big festival production. Worth knowing it's on if that world is ever on the radar, but it's a full step outside the lane.
5b8636a94da3.description: Insomniac's Lost in Dreams two-day festival at LA State Historic Park headlined by Porter Robinson, with Dabin, Louis the Child, Audien, ARMNHMR and What So Not, July 11-12, 18+.

5992d7ab4dcc.title_ref: Factory 93 presents: Beltran at Naud St

artist_notes.name: Beltran
artist_notes.note: Brazilian DJ/producer Juliano Beltran — founder of Beltools Records (deep tech, minimal, tech house); 'Smack Yo' on Solid Grooves broke him out with support from Michael Bibi, Pawsa, Jamie Jones. Driven, percussive tech house with Latin low-end influence and tight drum work.

5992d7ab4dcc.curator_note: Beltran at the Naud St warehouse is solid Factory 93 programming — his tech house sits in the Michael Bibi / Solid Grooves pocket, driving and functional without being anonymous. Factory 93's outdoor Chinatown space tends to run long, so this is a full-night commitment.
5992d7ab4dcc.description: Factory 93 presents Brazilian tech house DJ/producer Beltran at 1756 Naud St in Chinatown, from 5pm, $113+.

570a40fedd57.title_ref: Divine LA x Apt4B Radio present: The Groove Lab

artist_notes.name: Rosie Love
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (Rosie Love) active on the underground house/techno circuit — resident at Dada Bar and Apt4B Radio events; house and techno mixologist with a community-first approach to her events.

570a40fedd57.curator_note: Divine LA and Apt4B Radio run intentional, intimate electronic nights — Apt4B is known for no-phone 'mini-fest' events in lofts and smaller spaces. No marquee headliner, but the format guarantees a self-selecting crowd that's there to dance rather than watch. Good local option.
570a40fedd57.description: Divine LA x Apt4B Radio's 'Groove Lab' TBA DTLA house/disco/tech-house party with Rosie Love and residents, from 8pm.

1b2f8cd5a3d3.curator_note: The Vista running the 1972 Peanuts movie on a Saturday morning — a repertory matinee. Worth it if you're looking for something low-key and nostalgic to start a busy day. Not the main-event screen time at this venue.
1b2f8cd5a3d3.description: Daytime repertory screening of 'Snoopy Come Home' (1972, Peanuts animated film) at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, 10am.

d8572d218587.curator_note: Saturday evening showing of 'Dances With Wolves' at the Vista — same film as the Friday night screening, second chance if Friday doesn't work. The 7:30pm start puts you out by 10:30pm, which still leaves room for the later electronic options.
d8572d218587.description: Repertory screening of Kevin Costner's 'Dances With Wolves' (1990, 181 min) at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, 7:30pm.

1b9443748a23.curator_note: Saturday midnight Vista programming — same title as the Friday edition; for the cult-film crowd this is the prime version since the Saturday crowd tends to be looser. Worth noting if you're already at the Vista for 'Dances With Wolves' and want to stay for the midnight show.
1b9443748a23.description: Late-night cult screening of 'Hollywood 90028' (1973 exploitation thriller) at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, midnight Saturday.

artist_notes.name: Mike Servito
artist_notes.note: Detroit-born DJ, Ghostly International affiliate and longtime The Bunker NYC resident — marathon sets that move fluidly through acid, jacking house, techno and Chicago rhythms. Co-founded Detroit's queer Sass party; a respected underground name with deep Motor City roots and a New York club sensibility.

artist_notes.name: Jason Kendig
artist_notes.note: Detroit-born, SF-based DJ — member of Honey Soundsystem (the queer SF collective that shaped the city's underground), resident at Chicago's Smart Bar; marathon-format specialist with a crate spanning house, Italo disco, techno and acid. One of North America's most respected long-set selectors.
