80914459a356.curator_note: Servito and Kendig together is a real underground pairing — two Detroit-origin selectors who've built serious reputations through The Bunker and Honey Soundsystem respectively, both known for marathon sets that travel from Chicago jack to acid to disco without losing the thread. This is the Saturday-night TBA to chase if warehouse-underground is the mood.
80914459a356.description: SMD party presents Mike Servito and Jason Kendig at a TBA Downtown LA location, 11pm, late-night underground house and techno.

2759edca2c7e.venue_ref: TBA (Los Angeles) house, tech house, disco
2759edca2c7e.curator_note: This appears to be the same Groove Lab as the Divine LA x Apt4B Radio event above (same night, same format) — the 19hz listing adds the genre keywords 'house, tech house, disco' directly in the venue field, which confirms it. Cross-check before buying tickets; the RA listing is the more canonical version.
2759edca2c7e.description: Divine LA x Apt4B Radio's 'Groove Lab' TBA Los Angeles house/tech house/disco night, 8pm-4am, $12-34 — likely the same event as the RA-listed Groove Lab.

ca1a5336ad01.curator_note: Andrew Dominik's 2000 debut — Eric Bana's performance as Mark 'Chopper' Read is still one of the most committed pieces of character work in Australian cinema, and Dominik went on to direct 'The Assassination of Jesse James.' The Vista is the right venue for a Saturday screening of something this raw and stylistically confident.
ca1a5336ad01.description: Repertory screening of Andrew Dominik's 'Chopper' (2000, 94 min, Australian crime biography) with Eric Bana at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, 8pm.

3f495ac3b11f.title_ref: Factory 93 presents: Beltran Open to Close at Naud St

artist_notes.name: Beltran
artist_notes.note: Brazilian DJ/producer Juliano Beltran — Beltools Records founder; 'Smack Yo' on Solid Grooves broke him into the top tier with support from Michael Bibi, Pawsa and Jamie Jones. Percussive, groove-forward tech house with Latin low-end DNA.

3f495ac3b11f.curator_note: The Sunday open-to-close version of the Saturday Beltran show — same artist, same venue, lower price ($66 vs $113+) and a single-DJ all-night format which is actually the more interesting proposition. If Beltran's sound appeals, this is the one to pick: OTC sets tend to have a different arc than festival-slot sets.
3f495ac3b11f.description: Factory 93 presents Beltran playing open to close at 1756 Naud St in Chinatown, Sunday from 5pm, $66.

sounds_like: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang disco nights

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Veteran LA/SF house DJ (Scott Schroer) with 25+ years in the game and three Billboard Dance #1s ('Shiny Disco Balls,' 'You're Not Alone,' 'Shine Your Love') — moved from electro-mash to deep jackin' house and nu-disco edits; Sirius XM BPM / Vessel SF regular.

e1b7f6d3e828.curator_note: Paradisco is the monthly disco-house night inside the Line Hotel's Koreatown bar — a fun, art-deco-kitsch room with a lit dance floor, roller-skaters, and Scotty Boy keeping it broadly accessible. More nightclub-fun than crate-digging serious, but the setting is genuinely good for it.
e1b7f6d3e828.description: Paradisco monthly disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (inside the Line Hotel, Koreatown), 10pm to close, with Scotty Boy.

ccfacd3e3b24.key: embrz at harbor house rooftop|harbor house dtla|2026-08-08

artist_notes.name: EMBRZ
artist_notes.note: Dublin producer Jack Casey — melodic chill-house on Lane 8's This Never Happened imprint; BBC Radio 1 and SiriusXM attention; toured as support for Lane 8 and SG Lewis. Tranquil, emotional electronic, more headphones than dancefloor.

ccfacd3e3b24.curator_note: A rooftop set is genuinely the right format for EMBRZ — his chill-melodic house plays well in the open air at sunset but would feel thin in a proper club. The Harbor House DTLA terrace at 5pm is a low-stakes Saturday early-evening if the melodic/This Never Happened sound is your thing.
ccfacd3e3b24.description: EMBRZ (Dublin melodic-house, This Never Happened) plays an early-evening rooftop set at Harbor House DTLA, from 5pm.

6a22d168fab3.key: midnight lovers with isaac carter, harrison bdp, lubelski|tba - downtown los angeles|2026-08-08

artist_notes.name: Isaac Carter
artist_notes.note: London-based house DJ and producer; runs the Ochi imprint for vocal-led deep house; championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison, Seth Troxler and Floating Points — bridges Chicago/Detroit influence with a distinctly London sensibility.

artist_notes.name: Harrison BDP
artist_notes.note: Cardiff-born producer Harrison Webber — deep house and techno inflected with lo-fi, acid and jazz-funk influences since 2015; releases on Berg Audio, E&X Records and Clone; appeared at fabric London.

artist_notes.name: Lubelski
artist_notes.note: LA producer Jake Lubell — multi-instrumentalist using analog gear and vinyl sampling across a spectrum from psychedelic disco to techno-rave; key track 'Doses' (co-produced with Fritz Carlton) is one of Desert Hearts' biggest; albums on Dirtybird; remixed by Skream and Roman Flügel.

6a22d168fab3.curator_note: Midnight Lovers bringing three distinct selectors — a fabric-championed Londoner, a Cardiff analog-head, and LA's own Lubelski — for a TBA Saturday afterhours is a solid mid-tier bill. Not a marquee name night, but the range is more interesting than a one-genre booking.
6a22d168fab3.description: Midnight Lovers presents a late-night TBA-location party with Isaac Carter, Harrison BDP and Lubelski, Saturday Aug 8, midnight.

efabc7dd6d6a.key: phantoms pool party at level 8|level 8 dtla|2026-08-08

artist_notes.name: Phantoms
artist_notes.note: LA duo Kyle Kaplan and Vinnie Pergola — indie-dance and French-touch-inflected house; debut on Republic/Casablanca; 'Just A Feeling' (ft Verite) hit US Dance Radio #1 for four weeks. Not the underground end of the spectrum but polished, melodic indie-electronic with real pop appeal.

efabc7dd6d6a.curator_note: Level 8's pool format is the right venue for Phantoms — they play a radio-friendly, indie-dance take on house that's better suited to splashing around in the sun than a warehouse. If you want the rooftop pool party experience over a deep selection, this is the call.
efabc7dd6d6a.description: Phantoms (LA indie-dance duo) play an afternoon pool party at Level 8 DTLA, from 2pm.

24a39bacb767.key: karol g - viajando por el mundo tropitour|sofi stadium|2026-08-14
24a39bacb767.curator_note: Karol G's Tropitour is one of the biggest Latin touring productions of 2026 — she's turned reggaeton into arena spectacle on a par with any pop superstar. Not the electronic lane, but a genuinely massive show at SoFi if you're in for the full-scale Latin pop experience.
24a39bacb767.description: Colombian reggaeton/Latin pop star Karol G brings her Viajando por el Mundo Tropitour to SoFi Stadium, Inglewood, Aug 14.

1c14235e465f.key: moodymann and dj rashida play prince|the regent theater|2026-08-14

artist_notes.name: Moodymann
artist_notes.note: Kenny Dixon Jr. — Detroit house and soul icon, Mahogani Music founder; known for elusive, soulful, politically-charged sets that collapse the line between house, funk and jazz. A tracked name; this is a rare hybrid concept: a DJ celebration of Prince's catalog rather than a standard club night.

artist_notes.name: DJ Rashida
artist_notes.note: Detroit-rooted DJ and cultural tastemaker — signature fusion of hip-hop, funk, soul, dancehall and house; resident DJ for The Arsenio Hall Show; has collaborated with Erykah Badu, Kelis and Pharrell; one of Detroit's most celebrated selectors outside the pure techno lane.

1c14235e465f.curator_note: Moodymann doing a Prince tribute — with rare Prince visuals and DJ Rashida alongside him — is the kind of idiosyncratic, only-in-Detroit-by-way-of-LA event that you don't skip on principle. The Regent is the right mid-size room for it: theatrical but not stadium-scale, which is exactly what the concept needs.
1c14235e465f.description: Moodymann and Detroit DJ Rashida present an evening of Prince's music — DJ sets with rare Prince visuals — at The Regent Theater, DTLA, 9pm, 18+.

7de9287d2683.curator_note: Same Paradisco format as the Aug 1 edition — the monthly disco-house party inside the Line Hotel with no billed guest this time, just the residents. Reliable room, fun setting, but the lineup detail is thin; check for any last-minute guest announcements before committing.
7de9287d2683.description: Paradisco monthly disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (Line Hotel, Koreatown), Sat Aug 15, 10pm — lineup TBA.

artist_notes.name: Man Man
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-born, now LA-based experimental rock band fronted by Honus Honus (Ryan Kattner) — avant-garde indie with Eastern European, carnival-esque and Captain Beefheart influences; white tennis outfits and war paint on stage; energetic, non-stop sets with no breaks between songs.

artist_notes.name: American Tomahawk
artist_notes.note: LA-based support act; limited public footprint — described as having a dream-like alternative/chillwave sound. Included per billing.

4819e7c77dd7.curator_note: Man Man at the Echoplex is the Eastside live-band pick of the weekend — Honus Honus and crew bring a genuinely unhinged avant-garde party-band energy that's more in the Waits/Beefheart territory than anything on a dance floor. If you want something completely different from the club lane on a Saturday, this is the move.
4819e7c77dd7.description: Avant-garde rock band Man Man (Philly/LA, fronted by Honus Honus) play the Echoplex in Echo Park with opener American Tomahawk, Aug 15, 7pm.

e8ff8c423d38.key: karol g - viajando por el mundo tropitour|sofi stadium|2026-08-15
e8ff8c423d38.curator_note: Second night of Karol G's Tropitour at SoFi — same show as the Aug 14 date; pick whichever night has tickets. Big, polished Latin pop production for anyone in the mood for stadium scale over a club.
e8ff8c423d38.description: Karol G's Viajando por el Mundo Tropitour, night two at SoFi Stadium, Inglewood, Aug 15.

artist_notes.name: Maddix
artist_notes.note: Dutch DJ/producer Pablo Rindt — big-room techno-rave with trance and hard-dance influences; broke through with 'Ecstasy' (2019); releases on Spinnin', Armada, Revealed; launched his own Extatic (XTTC) label in 2023; DJ Mag Top 100 #69 (2024). Festival circuit — EDC, Ultra, Dreamstate.

d6d919ad1b86.curator_note: Maddix is solidly in the big-room rave-techno lane — harder, more trance-influenced than the fabric/underground end of the taste profile, and the Hollywood Palladium is a production-over-selection room. Worth knowing it's on, not a priority pick unless the Dreamstate/festival-techno energy appeals.
d6d919ad1b86.description: Dutch techno-rave DJ Maddix headlines the Hollywood Palladium, 8pm, GA 18+ / VIP 21+.

24e2924bf2f6.key: jason bonham's led zeppelin evening|vina robles amphitheatre|2026-08-21
24e2924bf2f6.curator_note: Jason Bonham's Led Zeppelin Evening is exactly what it sounds like — a tribute-format live show by John Bonham's son, playing through the Zeppelin catalog. A Paso Robles amphitheater is a long haul from Silver Lake; this is for the Zeppelin superfan, not a lane priority.
24e2924bf2f6.description: Jason Bonham's Led Zeppelin Evening — live tribute performance at Vina Robles Amphitheatre, Paso Robles, Aug 21, 7:30pm.

5ebf12f950ef.key: the miracles and the spinners|cerritos center for the performing arts|2026-08-21
5ebf12f950ef.curator_note: The Miracles and The Spinners are two of Motown and soul's most storied acts — 'Tears of a Clown,' 'I'll Be Around,' 'The Rubberband Man' — and the Cerritos theater is a seated performing-arts context rather than a club. For the soul-heritage deep cut, not the dance lane.
5ebf12f950ef.description: Motown legends The Miracles and The Spinners perform at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts, Aug 21, 8pm — classic soul and R&B from two Rock & Roll Hall of Fame-inducted acts.

artist_notes.name: Oguz
artist_notes.note: Dutch-Turkish DJ/producer Oguz Gülcenbay, based in Amsterdam — versatile across hard techno, melodic house/techno and electro-pop; emerged from Amsterdam's underground rave scene; launched his own 808 STUDIOS label/collective in 2025; known tracks include 'Golden Szn' and 'FC Horsepower.'

a4fbb098114f.curator_note: Mutate is Exchange LA's in-house techno series, and Oguz has the range to play melodic-peak or harder depending on the room — at Exchange he'll likely push the bigger, more driving end. A solid Friday techno option in a proper sound-system room downtown.
a4fbb098114f.description: Mutate series at Exchange LA presents Dutch-Turkish DJ/producer Oguz, Sat Aug 22, 10pm.

e59632d2236d.key: tucker wetmore: the brunette world tour |vina robles amphitheatre|2026-08-22
e59632d2236d.curator_note: Tucker Wetmore is a rising country singer-songwriter on the Zach Bryan wave — his debut 'Wine Into Whiskey' went Top 5 Country. Paso Robles is a hike, this is country, and neither fits the lane. Pass unless you've got a specific reason to be there.
e59632d2236d.description: Country singer Tucker Wetmore's Brunette World Tour at Vina Robles Amphitheatre, Paso Robles, Aug 22, with William Beckmann and Stella Lefty.

artist_notes.name: Noizu
artist_notes.note: LA-based tech-house producer — debuted on Chris Lake and Skrillex's HOWSLA in 2017; 'DANCE' on Black Book Records supported by FISHER, Chris Lake and Green Velvet; founded Techné Records, home to Dombresky, Westend, LP Giobbi and VNSSA. Plugged into the Black Book / Insomniac circuit.

e653cbe40068.curator_note: Noizu headlining the Shrine is a big-room Saturday tech-house show — he's properly embedded in the Chris Lake / FISHER ecosystem and the Shrine is a large, high-production venue rather than a club. If the mainstream tech-house lane is the goal for the weekend, this is a reliable choice.
e653cbe40068.description: LA tech-house producer Noizu (Black Book, Techné Records) headlines Shrine Expo Hall, Aug 22, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Mura Masa
artist_notes.note: Guernsey-born Alex Crossan — genre-fluid producer who debuted on XL with glitchy electronica/hip-hop hybrids; produced PinkPantheress' 'Boy's a Liar' and Haim's Grammy-winning remix. DJ sets lean indie-dance and bass-club rather than four-on-the-floor house.

d8180e2e3285.curator_note: A TBA-location warehouse show featuring Mura Masa feels like an unusual booking for this format — his sound sits closer to electronic pop and live-electronic than house or techno. Worth watching for lineup confirmation before committing to the Boyle Heights/DTLA logistics.
d8180e2e3285.description: Lights Down Low presents Mura Masa at a TBA warehouse venue in LA, 10pm.

d68fc247b802.curator_note: Club Blush at El Cid — the name and billing ('ethereal and euphoric') suggest a soft-house/disco/new-age dance night in the Silver Lake corridor. No headliner details; worth watching the RA listing for lineup confirmation.
d68fc247b802.description: Club Blush: An Ethereal & Euphoric Dance Night at El Cid Silver Lake, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Zepparella
artist_notes.note: San Francisco all-female Led Zeppelin tribute band — technically accomplished reproductions of the full catalog; guitarist Netta Stein noted for replicating Page's parts live.

9c2d4fcf620b.curator_note: A Led Zeppelin tribute at the Roxy is exactly what it says — well-played classic rock for fans who want the songs live. Not the electronic lane; mentioning for completeness.
9c2d4fcf620b.description: Zepparella, the all-female Led Zeppelin tribute band, at The Roxy Theatre in West Hollywood.

a40e575b8da3.curator_note: 70mm Odyssey at the Vista on a Friday — Nolan's epic is worth the screen. The 10:30pm start makes it a late-night closer to a full Friday rather than an early anchor.
a40e575b8da3.description: Late-night 70mm screening of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey at Vista Theater in Los Feliz, 10:30pm Friday.

3dfb0107c742.curator_note: John Carpenter's 1984 alien-visitor romance with Jeff Bridges — underseen compared to his horror output and worth catching on the Vista's screen. Clean 8pm pick before a later club night.
3dfb0107c742.description: Rep screening of John Carpenter's 1984 sci-fi romance Starman (Jeff Bridges) at Vista Theater in Los Feliz, 8pm Friday.

4a1af7cf2124.curator_note: Three local singer-songwriters at Gold Diggers — no wider profiles for Adam Spry, Adam James or The Pretty Flowers. Best treated as a warmup if you're heading to Acts of Service later.
4a1af7cf2124.description: Three-act indie/folk bill with Adam Spry, Adam James and The Pretty Flowers at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 7pm Friday.

artist_notes.name: B-Wade
artist_notes.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

7b5fd6a26231.curator_note: Same B-Wade soulful-house residency, now on a Friday — warm, gospel-adjacent, more about the feeling than the lineup. Reliable low-key eastside option if you want grooves without a big production.
7b5fd6a26231.description: Recurring soulful house night 'Acts of Service Sounds' at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, hosted by resident B-Wade, 10:30pm Friday.

artist_notes.name: Markus Schulz
artist_notes.note: German-born, Miami-based trance institution and Coldharbour Recordings founder — weekly Global DJ Broadcast since 2002; DJ Mag Top 10 for multiple years; known for marathon open-to-close sets fusing progressive trance and house.

bdd53b3c89a5.curator_note: An open-to-close Markus Schulz at Avalon is exactly what it sounds like — peak euphoric trance from one of the genre's most durable names. Not the rooftop-groove taste, but if a proper marathon rather than a curated selector set is what Saturday calls for, this delivers.
bdd53b3c89a5.description: Trance DJ Markus Schulz plays an open-to-close set at Avalon Hollywood, 10pm Saturday.

adb4a466d3c2.curator_note: Paradisco is KKBB's recurring disco night in Koreatown — no headliner listed, so residents only. Easy add if you're already nearby, but not worth reordering the Saturday around.
adb4a466d3c2.description: Paradisco recurring disco and house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown, 10pm Saturday.

artist_notes.name: Beau Didier
artist_notes.note: Amsterdam-based DJ (born 1999) making his LA debut — hard groove sound fusing ambient, techno and house; regular at Lofi, Radion and Club Basis in the Netherlands and BCCO/Vault Sessions-type underground events. Genuine European pedigree, very limited US exposure.

8de56ecb032a.curator_note: CLOSER's THERMAL night has been one of the more consistent TBA-format bookings in LA, and Beau Didier's debut is a real get — Amsterdam underground, hard groove techno-house, the kind of name you hear about before the bookings inflate. Worth the address chase if you're in the Saturday warehouse orbit.
8de56ecb032a.description: CLOSER presents THERMAL featuring Amsterdam DJ Beau Didier (LA debut) plus Kyrxmi, Hommes and ÖTAK at a TBA DTLA location, 11pm Saturday.

artist_notes.name: Kana Hishiya
artist_notes.note: Japanese DJ based in Los Angeles — dynamic fusion of house and techno, moving between punchy basslines, minimal, broken beats and psychedelic melodic passages; has toured US, Europe and Asia.

5a954993cb7d.curator_note: Disconic runs the same TBA-DTLA format as CLOSER and WORK — Kana Hishiya is the strongest name on this bill, a proper LA-based techno-house selector. The rest is local regulars; trust the format if you've been to a Disconic night before.
5a954993cb7d.description: Disconic collective night with Juniör, Kana Hishiya, John Smith and bilaliwood at a TBA Los Angeles location, 11pm Saturday.

968c997e8e52.curator_note: Sunday 70mm Odyssey at the Vista — same film, second chance. Good cap for a big Saturday if you missed Friday's showing.
968c997e8e52.description: Late-night 70mm screening of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey at Vista Theater in Los Feliz, 10:30pm Sunday.

f5167e64ce20.curator_note: Kevin Reynolds' 1985 college road-trip cult item rarely gets a proper theatrical run — early Costner, a script Spielberg championed, and a Vista screen to give it space. The 8pm timing sets up a clean double bill with the later Odyssey screening.
f5167e64ce20.description: Rep screening of Kevin Reynolds' 1985 road-trip film Fandango (Kevin Costner) at Vista Theater in Los Feliz, 8pm Sunday.

85002ef88213.curator_note: The Hustle at Gold Diggers — same format every first and third Saturday: boogie, classic disco, no headliner, short drive from Silver Lake. A recurring neighborhood pick.
85002ef88213.description: The Hustle recurring Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Stavroz
artist_notes.note: Belgian quartet (IJsbrand De Wilde, Gert Beazar, Maxim Helincks, Pieter De Meester) — evolved from DJ duo into live electronic band; blend acoustic and electronic instrumentation into cinematic, organic melodic club music on their own Moodfamily label. 'Gold Town' was on the GTA V soundtrack; played Coachella and Fusion Festival. A proper live act — not a DJ set.

66a16855b568.curator_note: Stranger Than landing Stavroz live at The Bridge is a real get — the Belgian quartet's sets are rare on the West Coast, and their acoustic-meets-electronic live format sounds different from a DJ set in a way that registers in a room like this. Worth building the Friday July 24 night around.
66a16855b568.description: STRANGER THAN presents Belgian live electronic act Stavroz at The Bridge in DTLA, 10pm Friday July 24.

9a9e02c8b47c.curator_note: A 2010–2015 pop and EDM nostalgia night — the title is completely honest about what it is. Not the lane; skip it.
9a9e02c8b47c.description: 2010–2015 pop and EDM throwback party at Catch One in Mid-City, 11pm Friday.

26d23103c09e.curator_note: Three-band rock bill at the Moroccan Lounge — Orion 224, Cannon the Dealers and American Woman are on the local circuit without wider profiles I can verify. Worth a look if any of the names mean something; otherwise a pass.
26d23103c09e.description: Three-band rock bill with Orion 224, Cannon the Dealers and American Woman at The Moroccan Lounge in the Arts District, doors 9:30pm, $12–15, all ages.

artist_notes.name: Sindri
artist_notes.note: Akbar Silver Lake resident DJ — hosts Horror/Fantasy/Italo/Goth-themed nights (Party Suspiria) and house/nu-disco/electro variety sets; long-running fixture of the Silver Lake queer underground scene.

artist_notes.name: Mondo Nexus
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the Silver Lake/eastside queer underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

99dad68671e5.curator_note: SEBASTIANE is named for the Derek Jarman film — Sindri's nights at Akbar tend toward Italo, goth-disco and queer underground. Intimate and unpretentious; the neighborhood Thursday pick over a bigger room.
99dad68671e5.description: SEBASTIANE queer dance night at Akbar Silver Lake with resident DJs Sindri and Mondo Nexus, 10pm Thursday July 31.

75b858e80852.curator_note: A dedicated K-pop rave at the Moroccan Lounge — BLACKPINK, BTS and current idol hits all night. Not the lane; mentioning for completeness.
75b858e80852.description: Next Level K-Pop Rave at The Moroccan Lounge in the Arts District, 9:30pm, $17–23, 21+.

artist_notes.name: DJ Slugo
artist_notes.note: Chicago OG — Dance Mania co-founding member alongside Paul Johnson and DJ Deeon; one of the original architects of ghetto house and juke/footwork since the early 1990s. Classics include 'Chicago Music'; Daft Punk name-checked him on 'Teachers.' Active via his Longevity Tour.

1c8c064e1849.curator_note: Baile World is DJ CQUESTT's LA global-club-culture party, and landing DJ Slugo on his Longevity Tour is a serious move — he's one of the original architects of juke and ghetto house, and hearing that sound from the source in a secret DTLA room is categorically different from any festival-stage recreation of it.
1c8c064e1849.description: BAILE WORLD presents Chicago juke/ghetto house pioneer DJ Slugo (Dance Mania) on his Longevity Tour at a secret DTLA location, 11pm, 21+.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

yaeji.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL Recordings, second album 'With A Hammer' (2023). Breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017. On a dedicated DJ-set North American summer tour 2026. Tracked name.

alima lee.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno; one of the most reliably excellent festival techno sets alive. Tracked name.

cloonee.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers. Tracked name.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house. Records on Ovum, M-nus, Cadenza, Cocoon.

hi-lo.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has released on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno bridging festival and underground.

elderbrook.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' with CamelPhat was Grammy-nominated 2018; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act, not a DJ set.

hayden james.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); worked with Gorgon City and Katy Perry; RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but slightly more radio-pop.

sidepiece.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house with Motown and '90s soul edits.

westend.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped define modern American tech house; Kick & Bass Records founder; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

josh baker.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project; also runs SYNTHO production school.

riordan.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm; also on Black Book and Catch & Release.

greg 99.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee (6.6M streams); Insomniac Records debut.

stacey pullen.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse in the '90s; Blackflag Recordings founder; acclaimed DJ-Kicks (1996); also releases as Bango, Kosmik Messenger and Silent Phase. Tracked name.

bae bae.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

nish.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

dj toka.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks; stripped techno to bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994, Tresor/Axis). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). Tracked name.

disco zombie.note: LA techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno; co-hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

onyx.note: LA-based underground techno DJ, active on the WORK / INCOGNITO circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

rubbermiro.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ Jacinda Gulley — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul. Tracked name.

enayet.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh; polyrhythmic club music with South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh.

k wata.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; produced for Yaeji; contributed to james K 'Friend' remix album.

discostan.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric sounds, re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW.

pocari g.note: LA-based house DJ active on the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

ashtre.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

oso disco.note: LA disco/house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

blaze claze.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

halo varga.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn Records, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owner of Artifact Record Shop. Deep Chicago house roots with a European finish.

dylan payne.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

highkin'.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

flying mojito bros.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda.

brainstory.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; primarily a live band, not a DJ act. Some groove DNA but a different lane from the dance floor.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew's solo project from Huntington Beach — immaculately crafted indie soul, alt-disco, boogie and Japanese city pop; primarily a live band but occasionally performs DJ sets. Influences include Vulfpeck, Toro y Moi and Yellow Magic Orchestra.

eli escobar.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

amelie lens.note: Belgian techno DJ and Second State label co-founder (with Pan-Pot) — hypnotic, driving peak-time techno; Factory 93 and Exhale-label regular, one of the most consistent techno headliners working. Tracked name.

charlotte de witte.note: Belgian DJ and KNTXT label founder — stripped, hard-hitting techno in the Berghain mold; one of the most booked names in European techno. Tracked name.

dj seinfeld.note: Swedish-born Armand Jakobsson — blurry, lo-fi deep house and indie dance with an emotional tug; 'Love In Stereo' EP on Ninja Tune helped break him wider. Tracked name.

mau p.note: Dutch DJ/producer Maurits Colijn — massive crowd-pleasing tech-house ('Drums Please', 'Your Mind Is Dirty') that sits at the mainstream/underground crossover. Tracked name.

vintage culture.note: Brazilian house/tech-house producer Lukas Ruiz — streaming mega-numbers, polished melodic house; runs the Canja Audio Culture label. Tracked name.

chris lorenzo.note: Birmingham-raised UK producer — playful, bass-heavy tech house and 4x4 with an '80s sample palette; 'Rave Digger' and 'California Dream' are floor staples. Tracked name.

pan-pot.note: Berlin duo Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix — founders of Second State (home to Amelie Lens, Luigi Madonna, Perc); driving minimal-techno sets built on years of Berghain residency.

massimiliano pagliara.note: Puglia-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with a Berghain residency — eclectic blend of house, electro-disco and techno on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton and his own Funnuvojere imprint; an under-the-radar pick with serious European credibility.

james axon.note: LA-based selector associated with the Midnight Lovers/Certified Groovers underground orbit — deep house and disco-leaning sets; limited wider public footprint.

gene on earth.note: California-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer and Limousine Dream label founder — lush, patient deep house and house that earns its running time; a Boiler Room favourite.

overmono.note: Welsh duo Tom and Ed Russell (brothers; Ed records solo as Tessela, Tom as Truss) — hard-edged yet melodic UK rave and bass music meeting the contemporary club floor; 'Good Lies' on XL is the album. Tracked name.

empire of the sun.note: Australian electronic duo Luke Steele and Nick Littlemore — theatrical, costume-heavy synth-pop and electronic; 'Walking on a Dream' was a global hit; now touring their 2024 LP 'Ask That God'.

polo and pan.note: Parisian duo Paul Armand-Delille and Alexandre Grynszpan — tropical-tinted French house, electropop and disco with an airy, globe-trotting feel; 'Ani Kuni' their biggest recent hit. Spotify core rotation artist here.

sacha robotti.note: Italian-German-Belgian-raised DJ/producer, Dirtybird mainstay since 2012 and Slothacid imprint founder — hypnotic, deep-bass tech house with a playful Ibiza edge.

lee burridge.note: British DJ and All Day I Dream founder — invented 'organic house' (slower BPMs, hand drums, acoustic textures); his ADID parties are the rooftop/daytime format done right.

radio slave.note: British producer/DJ Matt Edwards, Berlin-based — co-founded Rekids in 2006; drives propulsive, muscular house and techno; also records as Cabin Fever and The Machine.

doc martin.note: LA house legend since the late '80s — SF-to-LA transplant, Sublevel Records founder; mixes deep house, acid, tribal and classics in sets that shaped the West Coast dance scene.

justin martin.note: Dirtybird co-founder (with Claude VonStroke) out of San Francisco — melodic-but-tough house with real emotional depth; also runs the What To Do... imprint.

mikey lion.note: San Diego-born DJ and Desert Hearts co-founder (2012) — the hippy/rave underground end of US house and techno; Desert Hearts Records launched free in 2014.

dj colette.note: Chicago house vocalist and DJ, SmartBar resident, Om Records 'First Lady of House' — classically trained mezzo-soprano who sings over her own deep/pumping house sets; 25+ years in the scene.

davi.note: LA-based DJ/producer David Alvarado — deep, refined house and techno; Crosstown Rebels and Naked Lunch catalogue; co-runs the respected Long Island Electrical Systems series.

sofi tukker.note: NYC duo Sophie Hawley-Weld and Tucker Halpern — tropical-inflected dance-pop and house with Brazilian vocal layers and West African percussion DNA; Grammy-nominated for 'Drinkee'. Spotify core rotation act.

drama.note: Chicago R&B/electronic duo Na'el Shehade (producer) and Via Rosa (vocalist) — debut LP 'Dance Without Me' on Ghostly International; soulful, jazz-tinged club music at the R&B/dance crossover.

demuir.note: Toronto producer/DJ, self-described creator of the Jackin House genre on Beatport — Hammond B3-influenced soulful house; releases on Hot Creations and his own Purveyor Underground imprint.

tiga.note: Montreal DJ/producer Tiga Sontag — Turbo Recordings founder; threw Canada's first proper rave; sharp, ironic electro-house and techno that launched Chromeo, Gesaffelstein and Duke Dumont on his label.

vtss.note: Polish DJ/producer Martyna Maja, Warsaw/Berlin — industrial EBM, acid and sped-up trance blended into relentless high-speed techno; Repitch and Ninja Tune catalogue; Berghain regular.

anetha.note: French techno DJ/producer from Bordeaux — Mama Told Ya label founder; Berghain and Corsica Studios resident; her sets lean dark, hypnotic and distinctly European.

boys noize.note: German-Iraqi producer Alex Ridha — Boysnoize Records founder; electro-tinged techno and noise with hip-hop DNA; collaborated with Frank Ocean and co-wrote Lady Gaga's Grammy-winning 'Rain on Me'.

maceo plex.note: Cuban-American DJ/producer Eric Estornel — Ellum Audio founder; bridges melodic techno, house and electro with a Miami-rooted, big-room sensibility.

interplanetary criminal.note: Manchester-born DJ Zachary Bruce — UK garage and speed garage revivalist; co-founded ATW Records; 'BOTA (Baddest of Them All)' with Eliza Rose went UK #1 in 2022.

luuk van dijk.note: Amsterdam producer/DJ, born 1996 — releases on Hot Creations, VIVa Music and his own Dark Side Of The Sun imprint; contemporary tech-house with old-school warmth.

brutalismus 3000.note: Berlin duo Victoria Daldas and Theo Zeitner — nu-gabber, post-punk techno with hardcore and EBM edges; debut album 'Ultrakunst' (2023); collab with Boys Noize on their 2026 follow-up 'Harmony'.

la riots.note: LA-based production duo — tech-house and bass-house; known for Beatport-charting club cuts and festival circuit bookings.

collin reeve.note: LA-based DJ on the Certified Groovers underground circuit — deep, groove-oriented house and techno; regular TBA-location warehouse bookings.

mxm.note: LA DJ billed on the Certified Groovers circuit; limited wider public footprint — included per the billing.

doostah.note: LA-based DJ on the 6AM/Synthetik Minds circuit — techno and minimal; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

kitty logic.note: LA-based DJ in the WORK/6AM orbit — techno; limited wider public footprint, included per the billing.

taylor shockley.note: LA-based vinyl selector — deep house and disco edits, active on the underground all-vinyl circuit.

luke mele.note: LA selector on the downtown underground vinyl circuit; limited wider public footprint.

orlove.note: LA-based DJ/selector Orlovebynight — runs the Midnite City indie-disco party at The Moroccan Lounge; spins the electronic/indie crossover: Daft Punk, LCD Soundsystem, Soulwax, Justice edits.

neek.note: Southern California-based DJ/producer who blew up fast in the hard techno lane through viral social content and aggressive industrial-edged edits — organizer and resident for the Abstract LA series.

dea magna.note: LA-based live act — classically trained pianist who fuses hard techno and trance with her own vocals; releases on Reinier Zonneveld's Filth on Acid and Revealed. The live-singing-over-drum-machines format is her signature.

merimell.note: Estonian techno pioneer and Machine Nation founder — one of the first women in her country's techno scene; releases on Killekill (Berlin) and Desolat-adjacent labels; sets lean hard, fast and uncompromising.

kayzo.note: LA-based producer (Hayden Capuozzo) who won Insomniac's Discovery Project in 2012 — builds sets by colliding hardstyle, dubstep, trap and rock-inflected bass music; founder of Welcome Records. Firmly the festival-bass end of the spectrum, not the house lane.

blksoap.note: LA-born, Bay Area-based DJ and co-founder of Soul Source LA — eclectic underground selector moving through house, hip-hop, jazz and R&B; also founded the Textures party series and teaches in the Bay Area.

kobie dozier.note: LA/NYC saxophonist, composer and creative producer — performer and curator who has taken his 'For The People' tour across both cities; brings live musicianship energy into the DJ context.

roxswift.note: LA-based selector on the Soul Source / local underground circuit; limited wider public profile, included on billing confidence.

duma.note: LA-based DJ on the Soul Source circuit; limited wider public profile, included on billing confidence.

shanto.note: LA-based underground selector with broad range from downtempo to techno and deep to indie — active in the city's afro house and deep house circuits.

perstephanii.note: LA-based DJ active on the local afro house circuit, often billed alongside Shanto; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

amina jaguar.note: LA-based DJ and vocalist on the afro house circuit; limited verifiable detail beyond local billings.

young franco.note: Brisbane-born producer (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — ARIA-Gold-certified with 'Drop Your Love'; blends disco, funk, house and indie pop; debut LP 'It's Franky Baby' (2025). Festival-ready but with genuine groove DNA, not empty festival-tech-house.

nica.note: DJ on the Paradisco/Kiss Kiss Bang Bang circuit; limited wider public profile — included on billing confidence. Paradisco is the regular resident series at this venue.

okayval.note: Colombian-born, Jacksonville-based DJ/producer — rising fast in the tech-house and hard techno crossover space; tracks on Insomniac Records; known for dark grooves and heavy basslines.

xvirad.note: LA-based DJ active on the DTLA underground techno/house circuit; appears on the TECHTONIK and local warehouse billing. Limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

silvertone us.note: Philadelphia-based house DJ/producer — works across minimal tech, bass house and acid techno; active on the secret-warehouse circuit.

jacz.note: LA-based DJ on the DTLA warehouse underground circuit; included on billing confidence, limited verifiable wider profile.

linapary.note: Colombian DJ and producer based in Madrid — one of the rising voices in alter-perreo and guaracha; sets mix guaracha, tribal, baile funk and perreo with femme/queer politics baked in. Has played Whole Festival Berlin, Rinse France, La Machine Paris.

kebra.note: DJ/producer from CDMX/Brazil on the Club Cielo bill — Latin club and guaracha selector; limited public profile beyond this circuit.

dinabn.note: DJ behind the Club Cielo series at El Cid — resident curator setting the guaracha/tribal/Latin club format for the night; LA-based.

queenie us.note: US-based DJ on the Club Cielo bill; limited public profile beyond this Latin club circuit.

triptykh.note: Dallas-based hard techno DJ and Klangkuenstler signee — Beatport's leading US purveyor of schranz; debut 'Unholy' EP hit #1 on the all-genre Beatport EP chart. The name in this lineup if you're going for schranz over selection.

drakk.note: US-based hard techno DJ/producer — active on BeatStats' hard techno top-20 list; limited wider public footprint beyond the hard techno circuit.

adam auburn.note: LA-based DJ and Traxsource competition winner (2004) with an Insomniac-circuit pedigree — has played alongside Louie Vega, Hot Since 82, Derrick Carter and John Digweed; works the tech-house and deep-house spectrum. A Level 8 / Golden Hour regular.

rozzwell.note: LA-based selector on the Golden Hour / Trip to Ibiza circuit; limited wider public profile beyond local billings.

dvyn.note: LA-based DJ on the Golden Hour circuit; included on billing confidence, limited verifiable public profile.

dani thorne.note: LA-based hard techno DJ/producer — draws from Nico Moreno, Sara Landry and Brutalismus 3000; big mainstage presence (EDC, Ultra, Lollapalooza); 600k+ social following. Her sets lean raw and industrial rather than refined European techno. More festival-scale energy than the underground end of the taste profile.

gudfella.note: Philippines-born, LA-based DJ/producer Kyle Domingo — melodic and pop-adjacent house with 113M+ streams; 'Morning Coffee' and a Tiësto collab put him on festival maps; played Coachella 2026. Brighter and more radio-facing than the underground end of the taste.

local singles.note: LA-based DJ/producer on the Day Trip circuit; limited verified profile beyond local/circuit bookings.

day thief.note: LA-based DJ whose RA profile traces back to 2019; active on the city's underground circuit. Plays across house and electronic; limited wider verifiable profile beyond local bookings.

faited.note: LA-based DJ/producer on the local underground circuit; no verified label or broad profile found — included per billing.

david le brun.note: Listed in the lineup data; no verified artist profile found under this name in the electronic music context.

township rebellion.note: German duo Arthur Wagner and Marlon Mürle, founded 2012 — rose on Stil vor Talent, then breakthrough on RÜFÜS Du Sol's Rose Avenue after a headline Burning Man set; now on Factory 93, HILOMATIK and Truesoul. Melodic, atmosphere-heavy progressive techno with a festival-circuit audience; played EDC, Drumsheds, Electric Forest.

porter robinson.note: Highly produced melodic bass / future-house — household name, not annotated in detail. His 'Virtual Self' alias does harder club-adjacent material but this is a DJ set at his own-branded festival.

beltran.note: Brazilian DJ/producer Juliano Beltran — founder of Beltools Records (deep tech, minimal, tech house); 'Smack Yo' on Solid Grooves broke him out with support from Michael Bibi, Pawsa, Jamie Jones. Driven, percussive tech house with Latin low-end influence and tight drum work.

rosie love.note: LA-based DJ (Rosie Love) active on the underground house/techno circuit — resident at Dada Bar and Apt4B Radio events; house and techno mixologist with a community-first approach to her events.

mike servito.note: Detroit-born DJ, Ghostly International affiliate and longtime The Bunker NYC resident — marathon sets that move fluidly through acid, jacking house, techno and Chicago rhythms. Co-founded Detroit's queer Sass party; a respected underground name with deep Motor City roots and a New York club sensibility.

jason kendig.note: Detroit-born, SF-based DJ — member of Honey Soundsystem (the queer SF collective that shaped the city's underground), resident at Chicago's Smart Bar; marathon-format specialist with a crate spanning house, Italo disco, techno and acid. One of North America's most respected long-set selectors.

scotty boy.note: Veteran LA/SF house DJ (Scott Schroer) with 25+ years in the game and three Billboard Dance #1s ('Shiny Disco Balls,' 'You're Not Alone,' 'Shine Your Love') — moved from electro-mash to deep jackin' house and nu-disco edits; Sirius XM BPM / Vessel SF regular.

embrz.note: Dublin producer Jack Casey — melodic chill-house on Lane 8's This Never Happened imprint; BBC Radio 1 and SiriusXM attention; toured as support for Lane 8 and SG Lewis. Tranquil, emotional electronic, more headphones than dancefloor.

isaac carter.note: London-based house DJ and producer; runs the Ochi imprint for vocal-led deep house; championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison, Seth Troxler and Floating Points — bridges Chicago/Detroit influence with a distinctly London sensibility.

harrison bdp.note: Cardiff-born producer Harrison Webber — deep house and techno inflected with lo-fi, acid and jazz-funk influences since 2015; releases on Berg Audio, E&X Records and Clone; appeared at fabric London.

lubelski.note: LA producer Jake Lubell — multi-instrumentalist using analog gear and vinyl sampling across a spectrum from psychedelic disco to techno-rave; key track 'Doses' (co-produced with Fritz Carlton) is one of Desert Hearts' biggest; albums on Dirtybird; remixed by Skream and Roman Flügel.

phantoms.note: LA duo Kyle Kaplan and Vinnie Pergola — indie-dance and French-touch-inflected house; debut on Republic/Casablanca; 'Just A Feeling' (ft Verite) hit US Dance Radio #1 for four weeks. Not the underground end of the spectrum but polished, melodic indie-electronic with real pop appeal.

moodymann.note: Kenny Dixon Jr. — Detroit house and soul icon, Mahogani Music founder; known for elusive, soulful, politically-charged sets that collapse the line between house, funk and jazz. A tracked name; this is a rare hybrid concept: a DJ celebration of Prince's catalog rather than a standard club night.

dj rashida.note: Detroit-rooted DJ and cultural tastemaker — signature fusion of hip-hop, funk, soul, dancehall and house; resident DJ for The Arsenio Hall Show; has collaborated with Erykah Badu, Kelis and Pharrell; one of Detroit's most celebrated selectors outside the pure techno lane.

man man.note: Philadelphia-born, now LA-based experimental rock band fronted by Honus Honus (Ryan Kattner) — avant-garde indie with Eastern European, carnival-esque and Captain Beefheart influences; white tennis outfits and war paint on stage; energetic, non-stop sets with no breaks between songs.

american tomahawk.note: LA-based support act; limited public footprint — described as having a dream-like alternative/chillwave sound. Included per billing.

maddix.note: Dutch DJ/producer Pablo Rindt — big-room techno-rave with trance and hard-dance influences; broke through with 'Ecstasy' (2019); releases on Spinnin', Armada, Revealed; launched his own Extatic (XTTC) label in 2023; DJ Mag Top 100 #69 (2024). Festival circuit — EDC, Ultra, Dreamstate.

oguz.note: Dutch-Turkish DJ/producer Oguz Gülcenbay, based in Amsterdam — versatile across hard techno, melodic house/techno and electro-pop; emerged from Amsterdam's underground rave scene; launched his own 808 STUDIOS label/collective in 2025; known tracks include 'Golden Szn' and 'FC Horsepower.'

noizu.note: LA-based tech-house producer — debuted on Chris Lake and Skrillex's HOWSLA in 2017; 'DANCE' on Black Book Records supported by FISHER, Chris Lake and Green Velvet; founded Techné Records, home to Dombresky, Westend, LP Giobbi and VNSSA. Plugged into the Black Book / Insomniac circuit.

mura masa.note: Guernsey-born Alex Crossan — genre-fluid producer who debuted on XL with glitchy electronica/hip-hop hybrids; produced PinkPantheress' 'Boy's a Liar' and Haim's Grammy-winning remix. DJ sets lean indie-dance and bass-club rather than four-on-the-floor house.

zepparella.note: San Francisco all-female Led Zeppelin tribute band — technically accomplished reproductions of the full catalog; guitarist Netta Stein noted for replicating Page's parts live.

markus schulz.note: German-born, Miami-based trance institution and Coldharbour Recordings founder — weekly Global DJ Broadcast since 2002; DJ Mag Top 10 for multiple years; known for marathon open-to-close sets fusing progressive trance and house.

beau didier.note: Amsterdam-based DJ (born 1999) making his LA debut — hard groove sound fusing ambient, techno and house; regular at Lofi, Radion and Club Basis in the Netherlands and BCCO/Vault Sessions-type underground events. Genuine European pedigree, very limited US exposure.

kana hishiya.note: Japanese DJ based in Los Angeles — dynamic fusion of house and techno, moving between punchy basslines, minimal, broken beats and psychedelic melodic passages; has toured US, Europe and Asia.

stavroz.note: Belgian quartet (IJsbrand De Wilde, Gert Beazar, Maxim Helincks, Pieter De Meester) — evolved from DJ duo into live electronic band; blend acoustic and electronic instrumentation into cinematic, organic melodic club music on their own Moodfamily label. 'Gold Town' was on the GTA V soundtrack; played Coachella and Fusion Festival. A proper live act — not a DJ set.

sindri.note: Akbar Silver Lake resident DJ — hosts Horror/Fantasy/Italo/Goth-themed nights (Party Suspiria) and house/nu-disco/electro variety sets; long-running fixture of the Silver Lake queer underground scene.

mondo nexus.note: LA-based DJ on the Silver Lake/eastside queer underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

dj slugo.note: Chicago OG — Dance Mania co-founding member alongside Paul Johnson and DJ Deeon; one of the original architects of ghetto house and juke/footwork since the early 1990s. Classics include 'Chicago Music'; Daft Punk name-checked him on 'Teachers.' Active via his Longevity Tour.
